steps: Talk to Abigale in the south-east corner of Lumbridge Swamp. Dialogue: “Yes”.
Board the rowboat south of Abigale; it takes you to the manor.

Move the mirror to reflect the knives the murderer throws; a black swirl surrounds the wardrobe he throws from.

Pick up the killer's knife.
Equip the killer's knife, then select Fight on Abigale (no actual combat occurs).
Attempt to go through the sapphire door.
Talk to Mandy just outside the manor to complete the quest.

target.title: Stronghold of Security: starting capital of 10,000 Coins

places.label: Count Check — Lumbridge, south of the church: teleports to the Stronghold of Security

steps: The fastest way: talk to Count Check in the Lumbridge graveyard, south of the church: Talk-to, "Where can I learn more about security?", "Yes". He teleports you for free straight to the entrance, but only once and only if you have never been to the Stronghold.

Without the teleport: a canoe at Woodcutting 12-26 takes you from Lumbridge only as far as Champions' Guild (1 stop), then walk north-west along the river, about 2 minutes. At Woodcutting 27 the canoe goes straight to Barbarian Village.
Find the hole (Entrance) in the middle of the village by the mine and climb down.
Turn on run (the boot icon by the minimap) and do not attack the monsters: run from door to door.

The doors come in pairs. Between them is an empty corridor where nobody hits you: eat and recover here. At the second door there is sometimes a security question: the right answer is always that you never share your password, PIN or codes and do not trust links in chat.
Floor 1 (Vault of War): at the end open Gift of Peace for 2,000 coins. Then take the ladder down.
Floor 2 (Catacomb of Famine): the monsters are aggressive here, so do not linger. At the end open Grain of Plenty for 3,000 coins.
Floor 3 (Pit of Pestilence): open the Box of Health for 5,000 coins and a full health restore.
Floor 4 (Sepulchre of Death): open the Cradle of Life and choose Fighting boots or Fancy boots.

The way out is the home teleport: Magic tab, Lumbridge Home Teleport (the first icon), and do not press anything for about 14 seconds. It is free, once every 30 minutes; if the icon is grey the teleport is recharging, so go back by the ladders (Climb-up).

steps: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador Castle. Dialogue: “And how is life as a squire?” → “I can make a new sword if you like” → “So would these dwarves make another one?” → “Yes”.
Talk to Reldo in the library of Varrock Palace. Dialogue: “What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?”.
Talk to Thurgo south of Port Sarim and give him a redberry pie. Dialogue: “Would you like a redberry pie?”.
Talk to Thurgo again. Dialogue: “Can you make a special sword for me?”.
Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador Castle.
Climb up the east ladder in Falador Castle.
Go up the staircase west of the ladder on the first floor.
Search the cupboard in the room south of the staircase. Sir Vyvin must be in the other room, or he will notice you.
Bring Thurgo the portrait. Dialogue: “About that sword”.
Go down the ladder south of Port Sarim into the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. Ice giants and ice warriors attack here, so keep away from them.
Mine a blurite ore in the eastern cavern.
Return to Thurgo with a blurite ore and two iron bars. Dialogue: “Can you make that replacement sword now?”.
Return to the Squire with the sword to finish the quest.

steps: Talk to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim. Dialogue: “I'm in search of treasure” → “Yes”.
Talk to one of the Seamen on the docks in Port Sarim to sail to Musa Point (30 gp). Dialogue: “Yes please”.
Talk to Zembo in the Karamja Wines, Spirits and Beers bar and buy one Karamjan rum (30 gp). Dialogue: “Yes please”.
Pick 10 bananas nearby, then talk to Luthas about working for him. Dialogue: “Could you offer me employment on your plantation?” → “Will you pay me for another crate full?”.
Put the Karamjan rum into the crate.
Fill the rest of the crate with bananas (right-click Fill), then talk to Luthas.
Talk to Luthas and tell him you finished filling the crate.

Head back to Port Sarim and pay the Customs officer to sail there (30 gp). Dialogue: “Thank you, I'll be on my way” → “Can I journey on this ship?” → “Search away, I have nothing to hide” → “Ok” → “Search away. I have nothing to hide” → “Okay”.
Grab the white apron from the Port Sarim Fishing Shop (it hangs on the back wall).
Wear the apron and ask Wydin for a job in the Port Sarim food shop, then search the crate in the back room for the rum. Dialogue: “Well, can I get a job here?”.
Bring the Karamjan rum to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim; he gives you a key.
Climb up the stairs in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
Open the chest on the first floor with the key and take the Pirate message. Dialogue: “Ok thanks, I'll go and get it”.
Read the Pirate message.
Dig in the middle of the cross in Falador Park, and kill the Gardener (level 4) who appears. Once killed, dig again.

steps: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace. Dialogue: “Is there anything I can help you with?” → “Yes”.
Talk to Osman north of the Al Kharid Palace.

Have Ned in Draynor Village make you a wig from 3 balls of wool. He also sells rope: 15 coins via dialogue, 18 coins from his shop, or 4 balls of wool. Dialogue: “Could you make other things apart from rope?” → “How about some sort of wig?” → “I have them here. Please make me a wig”.
Dye the wig with yellow dye. If you need a yellow dye, Aggie in Draynor Village makes one from two onions and 5 coins.
Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village to get some paste. She needs ashes, redberries, a pot of flour and a bucket of water. Dialogue: “Can you make skin paste?” → “Yes please. Mix me some skin paste”.

Talk to Lady Keli in the jail east of Draynor Village and take a print of the key: use soft clay on the key. If you have already made the print, open the quest journal to re-sync. Dialogue: “Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!” → “What's your latest plan then?” → “How do you know someone won't try to free him?” → “Could I see the key please?” → “Could I touch the key for a moment please?”.
Use the key print on any furnace with a bronze bar in your inventory to make a bronze key (the nearest furnace is in Lumbridge).
Talk to Leela east of Draynor Village.
The level 26 jail guards inside the jail attack on sight and hit up to 3: walk past them, the quest does not need them dead.
Bring everything to the jail and give Joe three beers. Dialogue: “I have some beer here. Fancy one?”.
Use the rope on Lady Keli to tie her up.
Use the key on the prison door. If Lady Keli respawned you will need to tie her up again.
Talk to Prince Ali and free him (wear the wig, skirt and paste).
Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace to complete the quest.

steps: You need three goblin mails, which you can find around Goblin Village. The first is up the ladder in a crate in the south of the village.
The second goblin mail is in a crate in the western hut.
The third goblin mail is in a crate north of the generals' hut.
Use the blue dye on one of the goblin mails.
Use the orange dye (a mix of red and yellow) on another goblin mail.

Talk to one of the Goblin Generals in Goblin Village and show them the orange armour. Dialogue: “Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?” → “What about a different colour?” → “Yes” → “So how is life for the goblins?” → “Yes, Wartface looks fat” → “I have some orange armour here”.
Talk to one of the Goblin Generals again and show them the blue armour. Dialogue: “So how is life for the goblins?” → “I have some blue armour here”.

Talk to one of the Goblin Generals once more and show them the plain (brown) armour to finish the quest. Dialogue: “So how is life for the goblins?” → “Yes, Wartface looks fat” → “I have some brown armour here”.

steps: Talk to Willow outside Falador, south of the Ice Mountain dwarves. Dialogue: “Yes”.
Attempt to recruit Checkal in Barbarian Village.
Speak to Atlas in the Barbarian Village Inn to learn how to Flex. Pick up a cooked meat if you need one. Dialogue: “Yes”.
Talk to Checkal and flex your muscles to prove your worth.
Speak to Marley in the Edgeville ruins. Pick up the cooked meat from the Barbarian longhall if you don't have it already.
Ask the Cook at the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock for a steak sandwich. Dialogue: “I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?”.
Collect cooked meat, bread and a knife to make the steak sandwich.
Use the knife on the bread to make a steak sandwich. Be careful not to eat it!
Return to Marley and give him the steak sandwich. Be careful not to eat it!
Talk to Burntof in the Rising Sun Inn in Falador.
Buy an Asgarnian Ale for Burntof. Dialogue: “What ales are you serving?” → “One Asgarnian Ale, please”.
Give Burntof the Asgarnian Ale.
Beat Burntof in a match of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Your choices of Rock, Paper and Scissors do not matter. Dialogue: “Rock”.
Talk to Willow at the dungeon entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain. Dialogue: “Yes”.
Before you go in: take a pickaxe (any) and 10-15 Trout or Salmon, and check Mining is 10 or more. There is no bank inside.
Enter the dungeon again to finish the quest.
In the final room do not wait for the Ancient Guardian to leave you alone: it keeps attacking while you mine.
Fight it in melee, or mine a Structural pillar in one of the four corners (the Mine option): the pillar breaks and hurts the Guardian.
Eat when you need to (not later than when your health is within two hits of 7), then move straight to the next Structural pillar.
Repeat until the Ancient Guardian is defeated. If it hurts you faster than you mine, use the safespot: lure it to the east side and retreat into the entrance passage.
Watch the cutscene at the entrance to finish the quest. Dialogue: “Yes”.

steps: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library. Dialogue: “I'm in search of a quest.” → “Yes.”.
Search the marked bookcase in the library for the book, then read it (left-click the book in your inventory).
Talk to Reldo again. Dialogue: “Okay, I've read that book about the Shield of Arrav.”.
You and a partner join different gangs: one the Phoenix Gang, the other the Black Arm Gang. You cannot change later. The chat channel “OSRS SOA” finds a partner.
Talk to Baraek in Varrock Square: ask about the Phoenix Gang, not furs. Dialogue: “Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?” → “Okay. Have 20 gold coins.”.
Climb down the ladder into the Phoenix Gang hideout in south-east Varrock and talk to Straven. Dialogue: “I know who you are!” → “I'd like to offer you my services.”.
Kill Jonny the Beard (level 2) in the Blue Moon Inn and pick up the Intel report.
Give the Intel report to Straven in the hideout: he gives you the Weapon store key.
Search the chest in the hideout for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Talk to Charlie the Tramp at the south entrance of Varrock. Dialogue: “Is there anything down this alleyway?” → “I'm looking for the Black Arm Gang.” → “Do you think they would let me join?”.
Talk to Katrine down the alley to the west and join her gang. Dialogue: “I want to become a member of your gang.” → “Well, you can give me a try can't you?” → “Ok, no problem.”.
Get the Weapon store key from your Phoenix Gang partner, climb the ladder into the weapon storeroom in south-east Varrock, kill the Weaponsmaster (level 23) and pick up both Phoenix crossbows.
Bring both crossbows to Katrine, go up the stairs in the gang base and search the cupboard for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Pass the Weapon store key to your partner, then take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum: he gives you half of a certificate.
Swap certificate halves with a player of the other gang (a partner or a second account; alone, skip the quest: it is optional) and use the two halves together.
Give the Certificate to King Roald in Varrock Palace to finish the quest.

steps: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library. Dialogue: “I'm in search of a quest.” → “Yes.”.
Search the marked bookcase in the library for the book, then read it (left-click the book in your inventory).
Talk to Reldo again. Dialogue: “Okay, I've read that book about the Shield of Arrav.”.
You and a partner join different gangs: one the Phoenix Gang, the other the Black Arm Gang. You cannot change later. The chat channel “OSRS SOA” finds a partner.
Talk to Baraek in Varrock Square: ask about the Phoenix Gang, not furs. Dialogue: “Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?” → “Okay. Have 20 gold coins.”.
Climb down the ladder into the Phoenix Gang hideout in south-east Varrock and talk to Straven. Dialogue: “I know who you are!” → “I'd like to offer you my services.”.
Kill Jonny the Beard (level 2) in the Blue Moon Inn and pick up the Intel report.
Give the Intel report to Straven in the hideout: he gives you the Weapon store key.
Search the chest in the hideout for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Talk to Charlie the Tramp at the south entrance of Varrock. Dialogue: “Is there anything down this alleyway?” → “I'm looking for the Black Arm Gang.” → “Do you think they would let me join?”.
Talk to Katrine down the alley to the west and join her gang. Dialogue: “I want to become a member of your gang.” → “Well, you can give me a try can't you?” → “Ok, no problem.”.
Get the Weapon store key from your Phoenix Gang partner, climb the ladder into the weapon storeroom in south-east Varrock, kill the Weaponsmaster (level 23) and pick up both Phoenix crossbows.
Bring both crossbows to Katrine, go up the stairs in the gang base and search the cupboard for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Pass the Weapon store key to your partner, then take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum: he gives you half of a certificate.
Swap certificate halves with a player of the other gang (a partner or a second account; alone, skip the quest: it is optional) and use the two halves together.
Give the Certificate to King Roald in Varrock Palace to finish the quest.

steps: Enter Melzar's Maze north of Rimmington with the Maze key. Each coloured key opens one door and then crumbles, a wrong door too.
Kill the marked zombie rat for the red Key, open the red door with the floor tile (west wall, north end), then climb the ladder.
Kill the marked ghost for the orange Key, open the orange door with the floor tile (east wall, second from the north), then climb the ladder.
Kill the marked skeleton for the yellow Key, open the yellow door with the floor tile (south wall, furthest west), then take the ladders down to the basement.
Kill the marked zombie (blue key), Melzar the Mad (magenta key) and the lesser demon (green key), open the doors and the chest for the map piece.

steps: Talk to Almera on top of Baxtorian Falls, south of Barbarian Outpost. Dialogue: “Yes”.

steps: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree (make sure to have two empty inventory slots to start the quest). Dialogue: “You seem worried, what's up?” → “I'd be happy to help!”.
Go up to Hazelmere, on the island east of Yanille: on foot from Yanille (the fairy ring CLS opens only after Fairytale II, step S9-03).
Talk to Hazelmere; he takes the bark sample and gives you a message for the king.

Return to King Narnode in the Grand Tree and pass on the message. Dialogue: “I think so!” → “A man came to me with the King's seal” → “I gave the man Daconia rocks” → “And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!”.
Go up to Glough in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Talk to Glough.
Talk to King Narnode again in the Grand Tree.
Talk to Charlie on the top floor of the Grand Tree.
Return to Charlie.
Return to Glough's house and search the cupboard for Glough's journal.
Talk to Glough about his journal; you get arrested.
Talk to Charlie in the cell.
Talk to King Narnode outside Charlie's cell.
Travel with the glider (at the top of the tree) to Karamja to escape. Dialogue: “Take me to Karamja please!”.
Enter the shipyard on Karamja: say Glough sent you and give the password Ka-Lu-Min. Dialogue: “Glough sent me” → “Ka” → “Lu” → “Min”.

Get the lumber order from the Foreman on the southern docks. You can either kill him or talk to him (answer the security questions). Dialogue: “Sadly his wife is no longer with us!” → “He loves worm holes” → “Anita”.
Talk to Anita in the house west of the Grand Tree; she gives you a key.
Search the chest in Glough's house with the key and take the invasion plans (finish the dialogue).
Take the invasion plans to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.
Place the twigs to spell 'TUZO' in the watchtower in Glough's house. Return to King Narnode if you lost any. If your Agility is below 25, eat a summer pie.
Go down the trapdoor. Be prepared for the fight against a Black demon (level 172).
Kill the black demon. Stand just north of the stairs and the demon gets stuck behind the rocks; use magic, ranged or a halberd for up to 10 minutes.
Talk to King Narnode deeper in the cave (finish the dialogue).
Search the roots under the Grand Tree until you find the last daconia rock. If you lose the rock, it will be in the same root again.
Give the daconia rock to King Narnode under the Grand Tree to finish the quest.

Talk to The Lady of the Lake south-east of Taverley on the peninsula. Dialogue: "I seek the sword Excalibur."
Go to Port Sarim. (Make sure you have bread in your inventory.)
Enter the jewellery shop to the north.
Give the beggar your bread. Dialogue: "Yes certainly." Finish the conversation.
Go to the Zamorakian temple in the south-east corner of Varrock.
Check the Chaos Altar's inscription.
Return to Camelot with a tinderbox and enter the castle gates.
Go to the ritual site at the north-east corner of the Camelot castle grounds (a red star in the middle of 8 columns).
Stand on the star and light the black candle.
Drop the bat bones on the star.
The magic words are "Snarthon Candtrick Termanto".
Enter the castle and climb to the top of the south-east tower.
Smash the giant crystal with Excalibur. (Does not require 20 Attack, just use Excalibur on the crystal instead of attempting to wield it)
Talk to King Arthur.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Talk to Sir Gawain about how Merlin got trapped.
Go upstairs to talk to Lancelot.

Hide in Arhein's crate behind the Candle Maker's shop in Catherby.
Hide in Arhein's crate behind the Candle Maker's shop in Catherby.
Go up the stairs in the fortress.
Go up another floor.
Attack Sir Mordred down to 0hp to cause Morgan Le Faye to spawn.
Go through Morgan le Faye's dialog. IF YOU EXIT FROM THIS DIALOG YOU WILL HAVE TO FIGHT MORDRED AGAIN.

steps.t: Go grab the bucket in the bee field west of Catherby.
Use the insect repellent on a bee hive, then try to take some wax.
Talk to the Candle Maker in Catherby twice until he gives you a black candle.
steps.s: Talk to the Candle Maker in Catherby twice for a black candle.

steps.s: Read the altar in the Zamorak Temple in south-east Varrock.

steps.t: Enter the gates towards Camelot Castle.
Go stand in the star symbol north east of Camelot Castle.
Light the Black candle with your tinderbox.
Right-click drop the bat bones in the star.

steps: Go to the Exam Centre.
Ask an examiner about an exam. Dialogue: "Can I take an exam?"
Go to the Varrock museum and talk to Curator Haig Halen. He will give you a Sealed letter. Dialogue: "Have you any interesting news?"
Go back to the Exam Centre and talk to an examiner. The chat options do not matter; you will fail the exam regardless.
North of the exam centre at the hilltop with the blue urn, search the second bush to the east of the blue urn to find a teddy bear.
Take the panning tray.
Use the cup of tea on the nearby panning guide.
Pan the water at the panning points until you find a Special cup (browse through dialogue if stopped – referred to as "Shiny Cup" in dialogue). If you need an opal continue panning until you get one.
Steal from the workman near the panning points until you get an animal skull and specimen brush.
Run north to the female student with blonde hair and pigtails on the north-west end of the dig and give her the "teddy" by talking to her twice.
Run east to the student with a beard and a reddish-orange shirt and give him the Special cup by talking to him twice.
Run south to the student in a green shirt and give him the Animal skull by talking to him twice.

Return to an examiner. Dialogue: "Yes, I certainly am.", "The study of the earth, its contents and history.", "All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.", "Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used." – You should receive 'Level 1 Certificate'
Talk to all 3 students again.

Return to an examiner to take the second exam. Dialogue: "I am ready for the next exam.", "Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.", "Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.", "Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point." – You should receive 'Level 2 Certificate'
Talk to all 3 students – the female student will demand an opal (can be obtained by panning). Talk to her two times.

Return to an examiner for the final exam. Dialogue: "I am ready for the last exam...", "Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.", "Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.", "Handle bones very carefully and keep them amay from other samples." – You should receive 'Level 3 Certificate'
Back at the Exam Centre, go in the western room and search the cupboards on the north and south walls to get a rock pick and a specimen jar, respectively.
If you haven't already, steal a specimen brush from the Digsite workman.
Use the trowel on the soil in either level 3 digsite until you obtain an ancient talisman. Note: This step can take several minutes depending upon luck.
Talk to Terry Balando in the exam centre.
Use the invitation on any Digsite workman except the one by the western winch.
Use a rope on the western winch, then climb down.
Pick up one of the arcenia root in the room, search the bricks to the east, then climb back up.
Walk north-east to the northern winch, use the rope on the winch, and climb down.
Talk to Doug Deeping about the rocks. Dialogue: "How could I move a large pile of rocks?" Climb up the rope.
Walk to the tent to the south (marked with the orange vial), unlock the chest with the Chest Key and search to obtain chemical powder.
Use the trowel on the closed barrel to the west of the tent.
Use a vial on the barrel to get an unidentified liquid. If dropped, it will deal 25 non-fatal damage, and destroy the vial requiring you to re-open the barrel and collect more.
Grind the charcoal with your pestle and mortar.
Return to the exam centre and use the chemical powder and the unidentified liquid on Terry Balando (Note: make sure you right-click the liquid otherwise you'll empty it).
Mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together to create mixed chemicals, then add ground charcoal and finally arcenia root to produce chemical compound.
Climb down the western winch.
Use the compound on the bricks (not the rocks).
Use your tinderbox on the bricks.
Enter the large chamber, take the stone tablet. Low-levels should be wary of Level 22 skeletons.
Use the tablet on Terry Balando.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Bank all weapons and armour. Travel to Entrana.

Talk to Galahad and receive the holy table napkin. Dialogue: "I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King."
Travel to Draynor Manor's southern-most room with the holy table napkin in your inventory and pick up 2 magic whistles from the table. The whistles will not be visible until you enter the room.
Prepare for the fight against the Black Knight Titan.
Travel north-west of Brimhaven to the north-western peninsula (see the minimap image).
Stand under the tower and blow a magic whistle to be teleported to the Fisher Realm.
Fight the Black Knight Titan nearby on the bridge and kill the titan with Excalibur. See the in-depth quest guide for details.
Head south along the river and talk to the fisherman. Dialogue: "Any ideas how to get into the castle?"

Head to the castle, south-west of the fisherman, pick up the Grail bell from the ground and ring it. (You must stand in front of the bricks to gain access to the castle. Make sure NOT to use the Magic Whistle or you will be teleported outside and you will have to fight the Black Knight Titan again.)

Take the stairs to the south, and talk to the Fisher King. Dialogue: "I seek the Holy Grail.", "You don't look too well." (Make sure to talk to him about both options or you will have to kill the Black Knight Titan again if you leave.)
Travel to Camelot and talk to King Arthur. Make sure to have 1 empty slot in your inventory for Magic gold feather he gives you.
Travel to Goblin Village.
Use the Open option on the sacks in the house in the east side of Goblin Village.
Talk to Sir Percival, he will take your magic whistle. Make sure you have another to get to the Fisher Realm yourself. Dialogue: "Come with me, I shall make you a king."
Travel back to the Fisher Realm (via Brimhaven or using the fairy ring code . You do not need to fight the Titan again either way)
Head to the top floor of the castle's eastern tower and take the Holy grail.
Return to King Arthur.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Start the quest by reading the signpost in the centre of Canifis or by talking to Dr Fenkenstrain.
Take a pickled brain off the table in the tavern in Canifis for 50gp, or by using Telekinetic Grab.
Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain inside of Fenkenstrain's Castle. Dialogue: "Yes.", "Braindead", "Grave-digging"
Go upstairs by the eastern or western staircase to the bookcases and read:
Right-click dig at the cross-shaped grave marker in the Haunted Woods, south-east of Fenkenstrain's castle and immediately east of fairy ring .
Combine the decapicated head and the pickled brain.
Head north out of the Haunted Woods and use your star amulet on the easternmost memorial (south-east of Fenkenstrain's castle).
Push the memorial to enter the Experiment Cave.
Inside, kill a level 51 Experiment for the cavern key. If you have started Rag and Bone Man II, kill additional Experiments (level 25) for the Experiment bone.
Follow the north-western path to the end.
Search the chest and climb the ladder.
Right-click Dig at the three graves to get the torso, arms and legs.
Return to Dr Fenkenstrain (Fenkenstrain's castle teleport) and give him the body parts. Dialogue: "I have some body parts for you."
Talk to him again to give him the needle and thread.
Talk to the Gardener Ghost for the shed key (ensure ghostspeak amulet is equipped). Dialogue: "Do you know where the key to the shed is?"
Search the cupboard inside the shed to get a garden brush.
Take 3 canes from the pile of canes next to the shed
Use all the canes (3) on the garden brush to get an extended brush (using a total of 3 bronze wires).
Go upstairs to the western fireplace and use the extended brush on the fireplace for a conductor mould.
Go to a furnace (closest is in Port Phasmatys, teleport to Falador, fairy ring to Zanaris, amulet of glory to Al Kharid) and smelt a silver bar into a conductor (lightning rod).
Return to the castle, go upstairs and then climb the southern ladder to reach the lightning conductor.
Repair the lightning conductor.
Return to Dr Fenkenstrain and talk to him.
Go upstairs, then through the metal door, then climb the northern ladder.
Talk to Fenkenstrain's monster.
Go downstairs, then pickpocket the doctor for the Ring of Charos.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.s: Buy the pickled brain at the Canifis bar for 50 coins, or telegrab it.

steps: Enter the ruined house in the south-west of Mort'ton. Search the shelf on the wall. Read the diary. After reading the diary, the quest is started and you are able to create Serum 207.
If you didn't bring Tarromin potion (unf): Pick up the empty vials (can be filled in the house north-east) and search the smashed table for 2 grimy tarromin and one grimy rogue's purse.
Make two Serum 207 by adding clean tarromin to a vial of water and then adding ashes.

Use one dose on Razmire (afflicted) in the general store. Dialogue: "What are all these shadowy creatures?", "Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures." (Recommended to not use official Mort'ton temple World 377 yet to not get interrupted talking to the NPCs, until the step with repairing.)
Kill five loar shades and pick up their remains. Note: any shades that you killed before talking to Razmire will not count.
Return to Razmire and give him the remains. He may require more Serum 207.
Right click and open his General store, buy an Olive oil.
Open his builders' store, buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, 25 swamp paste and optionally a Flamtaer hammer.
Use the serum on Ulsquire Shauncy, located in the house east of the general store. Talk to him with Loar Remains.
Talk to him again and ask about the remains and the temple. Dialogue: "What did you find out about the remains?", "What can you tell me about that temple?"
Head north-east of Mort'ton and repair the temple until you reach 100% repair and at least 20 sanctity. (Recommended to use official world 377.)
Light the sacred altar in the centre of the temple (or wait until someone else lights it if you don't have level 5 Firemaking)
Use your olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil.
(Recommended) Use Serum 207 on the flame to make Serum 208, which permanently cures NPCs.
Use the sacred oil on a log to create a pyre log.
Head west of Mort'ton general store, to any grouping of 4 stone funeral pyres. Use the pyre log, then Loar remains on a funeral pyre.
Light the funeral pyre. Note: This will grant 25 Prayer XP.
Collect the reward.
(Recommended) Use the Serum 208 on Razmire.
Use the Serum 208 on Ulsquire and finish the dialogue.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Vanstrom Klause in the Canifis pub (near the staircase). Dialogue: "Why do they need help? Are they in trouble?", "Perhaps I could help you out here."
Grab the 6 wooden planks, 10 coins, a hammer, all the steel weapons and nails, and fill your Druid Pouch if you haven't done so already before teleporting!

Repair the bridge.

Talk to Veliaf (no chat options needed).

Talk to Veliaf (talk to him and give him your steel weapons).

Kill the level 97 Skeleton Hellhound (you can safespot the hellhound by luring it to the north-east side of the room, to the right of the north barrel or below the north-east bed shown in the picture on the right).
Talk to Veliaf, ask how to get out. Dialogue: "How do I get out of here?", "Ok, thanks."
Go back by entering the cave entrance and search the wall to the north.
Climb up the ladder in the north side of the room.
Talk to the Stranger in the Canifis pub (the one sitting in the chair where Vanstrom Klause was).
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to the Warrior south-east of Draynor Village. Dialogue: “What are you camped out here for?” → “What makes you think it's out here?” → “If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?” → “Looks like you don't know either” → “Yes”.
Try cutting the tree just to the west; a leprechaun appears. Dialogue: “I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city”.
Talk to Shamus. Dialogue: “I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city”.
Bank all weapons and armour you have (including the axe), go to Port Sarim and take the boat to Entrana.
Climb down the ladder on the north side of the island. Once you go down, you can only escape via teleport. Dialogue: “Well that is a risk I will have to take”.
Kill the zombies (level 25) with Fire Strike until one drops a bronze axe.
Run past the greater demons to the south and chop the Dramen tree from its south side: a Tree Spirit (level 101) appears.
Kill the Tree Spirit with Fire Strike from between the mushrooms to the south-west.
Cut at least one branch from the Dramen tree. It's recommended you cut at least 4 branches so you don't have to return in future quests.
Teleport away with the branches, preferably to Lumbridge.
Use a knife on the Dramen branch to craft a Dramen staff.
Enter the shed south of Lumbridge with your Dramen staff equipped; this is the entrance to Zanaris.

steps: To start, talk to Brother Kojo at the Clock Tower. Dialogue: "OK old monk, what can I do?" Note: if he gives you a Watch speak to him again
Go down the ladder in the middle room.
Follow the path to a hub with four doors.
Head through the south-eastern door.
Walk down the passageway until you see some Ogres.
Pick up the red cog.
Head back to the ladder.
Climb up to the and use the red cog on the red spindle (located on the column beside the ladder, facing north).
Go outside of the Clock Tower and head east to where Brother Cedric is (South of Ardougne zoo).
Go down the ladder east of Brother Cedric.
Follow the tunnel to the end.
Push the wall to get inside and pick up the blue cog.
Climb up the ladder.
Head to the centre room of the Clocktower and climb the staircase to the .
Use the blue cog with the blue spindle (the spindle on the south side of the column).
Head back to the basement and go through the north-eastern door
Use the bucket of water with the cog or simply wear your ice gloves to pick up the cog. Make sure to finish the dialogue or you will not pick up the cog.
Head back to the ladder. (Do not climb up the ladder)
Use the black cog with the black spindle. (In the basement of the Clock Tower on the east side of the column).
Head through the north-western door.
Pick up the rat poison to the north-west.
Head to the end of the tunnel
Pull the levers up to open the rat cage.
Use the rat poison with the food trough.
Wait until all the rats have died.
Head through the western gate.
Pick up the white cog.
Climb-up the ladder.
Head inside to the top floor.
Use the white cog with the white spindle at the top of the clocktower (the spindle on the west side of the column).
Head back down and talk to Brother Kojo for your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Speak to Denulth in the Burthorpe camp. Dialogue: "Do you have any quests for me?", "No, but perhaps I could try and find one?"
Ask Eohric on the of the castle about the guard that was on duty last night. Dialogue: "I'm looking for the guard that was on last night."
Speak to Harold upstairs in the bar in Burthorpe. Dialogue: "You're the guard that was on duty last night?"
Speak to Eohric again.
Go back to Harold.
Give him an Asgarnian ale.
Bet with Harold, you must bet over 60 gold (101 to immediately bankrupt him). Dialogue: "Would you like to gamble?"
Gamble until he gives you an "IOU". Read it to receive the combination.

Go to the castle and place the 5 coloured balls as shown in the image. The door will unlock (you have to read the note for this to work). Keep the note as you will need it to finish the quest, though if lost it can be reclaimed from Harold for free.
Go north-west of Burthorpe, enter the cave.
Ask Saba about another way up Death Plateau. Dialogue: "Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?"
Leave the cave, continue north-west then go south at the fork.
Talk to Tenzing. Dialogue: "OK, I'll get those for you."
Talk to Dunstan by the anvil in north-east Burthorpe.
Talk to Denulth where you started the quest, who will give you a certificate.

Talk to Dunstan to exchange your climbing boots, certificate and iron bar for spiked boots. (If you already own a pair of spiked boots, Dunstan will take the certificate, and then continue to the next step)
Return to Tenzing; give him 10 bread, 10 trout and the spiked boots to get the map. The bread and trout must be un-noted, and the items must be given all in one go.

Exit Tenzing's house through the north door and then climb over the stile. Take the path north and around to the east (past the second mountain goat) until the message "I think this is far enough" appears in the chat box (NOT the Death Plateau warning, this is another message; you can ignore the warning, since the trolls only attack you on the main path).
Talk to Denulth (make sure you have the combination with you when you do).
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: In Seers' Village, go to the house immediately south of the anvil.
Search the bookcase on the eastern wall to find a battered book.
Read the book, then use a knife on it to get a Battered key.
Go to the building with anvil and open the Odd looking wall in the north (with the key in inventory).
Go down the stairs.
Go into the room to the north.
Turn the water controls east of the water wheel.
Turn the water controls west of the water wheel.
Pull the lever by the water wheel.

(Optional) Kill one of each of the Elemental to complete Kandarin Easy Task. For the Earth Elemental, you must defeat one of the actual Elementals walking around; the rock that turns into the Elemental won't count towards the requirement.
(Optional) To obtain leather, search a crate north of the staircase in the middle room.
(Optional) To obtain a needle, search the two stacked crates on the left as you enter the west room.
Go to the eastern room.
With a needle, thread, and leather, fix the bellows.
Pull the lever by the bellows.
Go to the middle room and search the boxes in the north-east to get a stone bowl.
Go to the south room.
Use a stone bowl on the lava trough to the south.
Use the bowl of lava on the Furnace in the room.
Go to the western room and mine an elemental rock.
Kill the Earth elemental and pick up the elemental ore it drops (get 2 more ores if you are planning to do Elemental Workshop II).
Use the elemental ore and four coal on the furnace in the southern room. You will get an Elemental metal.
With the slashed book, go to the middle room and smith an elemental shield by using the elemental metal on the workbench.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Search the boxes in the north east of the central room.

Drop a bloated toad where the arrow points.

Pluck the carcass and take the raw chompy.
Talk to Rantz.
Go back into the cave and talk to Fycie and Bugs.
Obtain the ingredients that they've asked for. The image on this page shows their location.
Use the raw chompy on the spit-roast north of Rantz (the fire outside of the cave).
Talk to Rantz.

steps: Talk to Bert in Yanille, in the house next to the POH Portal to get a Sandy hand. Dialogue: "Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?", "Yes."
Go to the Dragon Inn pub south of Bert's house. Buy a beer from the bartender (if you don't have one) and give the beer to the Guard Captain.

Ring the bell at the Wizards' Guild (outside near eastern doors), or enter the guild with 66 Magic, then talk to Zavistic Rarve, who will take the Hand. If started Zogre Flesh Eaters: Dialogue: "I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you."
Talk to Bert to get Bert's rota.
Travel to Brimhaven and find Sandy in a small house south of The Shrimp and Parrot restaurant and north-west of the pub.
Search Sandy's desk to get Sandy's rota.
Pickpocket Sandy until you get sand.
Travel back to Yanille and talk to Bert to receive a magic scroll.
Ring the bell just outside the Wizards' Guild and talk to Zavistic Rarve again to receive a magical orb.
Talk to Zavistic Rarve again. He will offer to teleport you to Port Sarim. Dialogue: "Can you help me more?", "Yes, that would be great!" (Dialogue: if started Zogre Flesh Eaters)
Talk to Betty in Port Sarim Magic shop for a bottled water. Dialogue: "Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand."
First add redberries, then white berries to the bottled water in order to get a pink dye.
Dye the lantern lens to get a rose-tinted lens.
Talk to Betty again so she puts the vial on the counter. Dialogue: "Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand."
Go stand in the doorway and "use" the lens on the counter to get a truth serum.
Talk to Betty one last time with sand in your inventory. Dialogue: "Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand."
Travel to Brimhaven and talk to Sandy.

Activate the magical orb and talk to Sandy again. Be sure to click every option. Dialogue: "Why is Bert's rota different from the original?", "Why doesn't Bert remember the change in his hours?", "What happened to the wizard?"
Travel to Yanille and Ring the Bell at the Wizards' Guild to talk to Zavistic Rarve.
Talk to Zavistic Rarve again to get a cut scene.
Travel to Entrana and talk to Mazion at the sandpit to get a Wizard's head.
Return to Yanille, ring the bell and talk to Zavistic Rarve.

steps.t: Talk to Bert in west Yanille.
Give the Guard Captain in the pub south of Bert a beer. The pub sells one for 2 coins.
steps.s: Give the Guard Captain in the Yanille pub a beer.

steps.s: Ring the Wizards' Guild bell; talk to Zavistic Rarve.

steps.t: Return to Bert in west Yanille.
Travel to Brimhaven, enter Sandy's building south of the restaurant and search Sandy's desk for the rota.
steps.s: Search Sandy's desk in Brimhaven for the rota.

steps.t: Pickpocket Sandy for some sand.
Return to Bert in west Yanille with the rota and sand.
Ring the bell outside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and talk to Zavistic Rarve when he appears.
steps.s: Ring the Wizards' Guild bell; talk to Zavistic Rarve.

steps.t: Travel to Port Sarim, and talk to Betty in the magic shop.

Use redberries on the bottled water.

Talk to Betty with the pink lens.
Stand in Betty's doorway and use the rose-tinted lens on the counter.
Stand in Betty's doorway and use the rose-tinted lens on the counter.
Talk to Betty again.
Talk to Sandy in Brimhaven again with the truth serum, choosing distractions until one works.
steps.s: Distract Sandy in Brimhaven while holding the truth serum.

steps.t: Use the truth serum on Sandy's coffee mug.
Activate the magical orb next to Sandy.
Ask Sandy every question with the magical orb in your inventory.
steps.s: Ask Sandy every question with the magical orb.

steps.t: Return to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille, ring the bell and talk to Zavistic Rarve when he appears.
steps.s: Ring the Wizards' Guild bell; talk to Zavistic Rarve.

steps.t: Give Zavistic Rarve 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand.
Travel to Entrana (bank all combat gear first) and talk to Mazion at the sand pit.
steps.s: Talk to Mazion at the Entrana sand pit.

steps.t: Return to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille, ring the bell and talk to Zavistic Rarve to finish the quest.
steps.s: Ring the guild bell; Zavistic Rarve finishes the quest.

steps: Speak to Tomas Lawry outside the Port Piscarilius bank.Dialogue: "I'm looking for a quest.", "Absolutely.", "Yes." (Grab a bowl from the general store on your way to the bank if you plan on making the stew yourself.)

Head south and speak to Robert O'Reilly in the house directly west of the bridge. He will ask for a stew. Dialogue: "Okay." A stew can be made with raw beef and a potato purchased from Kenelme directly west along with a bowl from the general store south-east.
Enter the manhole to the east marked by the File:Dungeon map link icon.png icon, cross the bridge a bit to the south, continue west.
Speak to Devan Rutter, near the fish stall. Dialogue: "Nope, sounds good to me."
Optional: Trade the General Store Shop Keeper in The Warrens for an easy Kourend & Kebos Diary task.
Return to the surface from the way you entered and murder Conrad King (non-combat) on the dock on the southern side of the Piscarilius Foodhall (the largest building). Pick either option.
Go back down the manhole and enter the tent.
Speak to the Queen of Thieves.
Exit the sewers and travel south-west to Kingstown and enter the house immediately north from the entrance (south of the File:Rare trees icon.png icon), and climb the stairs to the .
Picklock the chest in the east side of the room to find a letter. (You may have to click the lock multiple times)
Return to Tomas Lawry. Dialogue: "Let's talk about my quest."
Return to The Queen of Thieves (now called Lady Shauna Piscarilius).
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Travel to the Ruins of Uzer via the necklace of passage teleport to Eagle's Eyrie and run south-east. You can alternatively use a fairy ring () and go north-east.
Pick up and read the Letter west of the broken clay golem
Talk to the golem. Dialogue: "Shall I try to repair you?"
Use four soft clay on the golem. If you chose to bring a pickaxe and a bracelet of clay, clay rocks can be found to the north-west, near the shore. The phoenix can be found there as well.
Talk to the golem again. Dialogue: "How do I open the portal?"
Pick a black mushroom near the stairs east of the golem before heading down (or downstairs at your right).
Climb down the stairs in the ruins.
Take the strange implement from the north-western room.
Speak to the Golem again Dialogue: "How do I open the portal?"

Head to the most north-eastern part of the Digsite, near the large buried skeleton, and talk to Elissa. Dialogue: "I found a letter in the desert with your name on." (make sure to read the letter if no 3rd option is seen)
Head to the Exam Centre just south of the Digsite.
Search the bookcase in the south-east corner and read Varmen's notes.

Talk to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum about the statuette. Dialogue: "I'm looking for a statuette recovered from the city of Uzer.", "I want to open a portal to the lair of an elder-demon." (Dialogue: if Bone Voyage is started)
Pickpocket him for the display cabinet key.
Head upstairs, and open the second-most western case in the northern-most row. You will get a statuette.
Return to the Kharidian Desert (fairy ring ), or teleport to Eagle's Eyrie with Necklace of passage.
Return to the ruins of Uzer where you started the quest and again go down the stairs.
In the centre of the room will be four alcoves. Place the statuette in the empty one.
Turn the statues until they all point north.
Go north, through the double doors.
Optional: Use your chisel and hammer on the throne for 2 sapphires, emeralds, and rubies.
Otherwise, immediately go back through the south portal.
Go back upstairs and talk to the golem.
With an empty vial in your inventory, grind the black mushroom using a Pestle and mortar.
Use the phoenix feather on the black dye to make a phoenix quill pen.
Talk to the golem
Use the phoenix quill pen on a piece of papyrus to get the golem program.
Use the strange implement on the golem then quickly use the newly acquired golem program on the golem.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Begin the quest by talking to Irena, located just south of Shantay Pass (fairy ring , then run north-east). Dialogue: "What's the matter?"
Go to the Desert Mining Camp entrance (south of Irena).

Talk to the Mercenary Captain. Dialogue: "Wow! A real captain!", "I'd love to work for a tough guy like you!", "Can't I do something for a strong Captain like you?", "Sorry Sir, I don't think I can do that.", "It's a funny captain who can't fight his own battles!"
He will attack you. Kill him and get the key of the gate. (All damage can be dealt via recoil)
Unequip any weapons AND armour and enter the gate.

Talk to the Male slave on the east wall (not the south-east wall) when no guard is nearby. Dialogue: "I've just arrived.", "Oh yes, that sounds interesting.", "What's that then?", "I can try to undo them for you.", "It's funny you should say that...", "Yeah, okay, let's give it a go.", "Yes, I'll trade." If a guard sees you, you are jailed: bend the window bars, climb out, climb the rock wall and cliff, and enter through the gate again.
Equip the slave's clothes
Enter the mine to the north
Follow the path until you reach a guarded cave entrance.
Talk to one of the guards until he mentions a Tenti pineapple. Dialogue: "I'd like to mine in a different area.", "Yes sir, you're quite right sir.", "Yes sir, we understand each other perfectly."
Run back to the surface, unequip ALL pieces of your slave robes and leave the desert camp through the front gate, or return to fairy ring .
Talk to Al Shabim in the south tent in the Bedabin Camp (directly west of the Desert Mining Camp). You will be given a Bedabin key. Dialogue: "I am looking for a pineapple.", "Yes, I'm interested."

Go back to the Desert Mining Camp. (Make sure to put on your slave outfit (and unequip anything else) before entering the gate. If you inadvertently dropped your slave outfit, you can get another one from a slave by repeating the earlier trade with the desert clothing.)
Go up the ladder in the jail building and search the southernmost bookcase on the western wall. A message should pop up stating "You notice several books on the subject of sailing."
In the same room, talk to Captain Siad. Dialogue: "I wanted to have a chat?", "You seem to have a lot of books!", "So, you're interested in sailing?", "I could tell by the cut of your jib."
Open the chest to obtain the technical plans. (Make sure you click continue, so the plans go to your inventory)
Go back to the Bedabin Camp and show Al Shabim the plans. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm very interested.", "Yes, I'm kind of curious."
Use the anvil in the northern tent. Following the plans, create a prototype dart.
Take the dart to Al Shabim, who will in return give you the Tenti pineapple.
Equip your Slave outfit and head back to the guards in the mine with your pineapple and give it to one of them.
Go through the cave entrance and head east until you're beside the mine cart.
Right-click search the nearby barrels to get a barrel. Dialogue: "Yeah, cool!"
Get into the mine cart by right-click searching it. Dialogue: "Yes, of course." (If you fail to start the cutscene redo this step)
Take the west-north-west path and use a barrel on Ana (blonde hair at the end of the second north-western path).
Head back to the mine cart. Put Ana in the mine cart, then take the cart yourself. Dialogue: "Yes, of course."
Search nearby barrels to find Ana.
Put Ana on the winch bucket (north-west area of room).
Don't raise the guard's suspicions when he offers help. Dialogue: "Yes please.", "I said you were very gregarious!"
Head back to the surface.
Operate the winch (south-west in the camp), then search the barrel west of the winch to find Ana. (Do not go through the gate)
Put Ana on the wooden cart at the centre of the Camp.

Talk to the mine cart driver. Dialogue: "Nice cart.", "One wagon wheel says to the other, 'I'll see you around'.", "'One good turn deserves another.'", "Fired... no, shot perhaps!", "In for a penny in for a pound.", "Well, you see, it's like this...", "Prison riot in ten minutes, get your cart out of here!", "You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!"
Get on the cart by searching it. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll get on."
Head back to Irena for your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Go to the house west of the The Cloak and Stagger tavern in Shayzien. (Xeric's Talisman - 1. Xeric's Lookout and run north-west, or Fairy Ring )
Speak to Phileas Rimor, and agree to help him. Dialogue: "Do you need help with anything?", "Yes."
Gather a ranged weapon, a melee weapon (a pickaxe counts as a valid melee weapon), and runes to perform any magic attack if you have not already.
Go to the Arceuus Library (Fairy ring or Lovakengj Minecart Network) and speak to Archeio to teleport to the Library Historical Archive.
Speak to Pagida, and agree to be teleported into the Tower of Magic prison. Dialogue: "I have a question about King Shayzien VII.", "Yes please."
Push the strange device all the way west. From the north side, attack the device using magic.
From the south side, attack using melee. (Note: Make sure your NPC attack options are not set to hidden, or the Attack option will not appear!)
Push the strange device all the way east. From the south side, attack using ranged.
Investigate the skeleton in the northern cell.
Return to the quest start and talk to Phileas Rimor (Xeric's Talisman - 1. Xeric's Lookout and run north-west).
Go north-west to the War Tent in the south-west corner of the Shayzien Encampment. Go upstairs and speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien.
Travel to the summit of Mount Quidamortem. (Lovakengj Minecart Network or Xeric's Talisman - 5. Xeric's Honour if it is unlocked) or Fairy ring (if unlocked)
Speak to Historian Duffy. (near the water symbol on the minimap)
Use a rope on the crevice on the western side of the mountain, and enter the crevice. Go around to the south, not through the middle. (near the ! symbol on minimap)
Mine the Boulder.
Push the Boulder.
Attempt to pass the magic gate, and kill the Corrupt Lizardman.
Pass through the magic gate and inspect the Unstable Altar.
Hop worlds after you finish the dialogue to quickly leave the cave.
Speak to Historian Duffy again.
Go back to the unstable altar in the cave.
Speak to Duffy and then Gnosi near the unstable altar. Make sure to speak to them BOTH.
Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien back at the war tent (Fairy ring , Lovakengj Minecart Network, or Speak to the Mountain Guide).
Return to Phileas's house and walk inside to get dialogue. He will not be there.
Return to Lord Shiro Shayzien once more.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Speak to the Dwarven Boatman. ( then go through the tunnel to the south west. Once inside proceed through the Cave Entrance directly ahead between the two statues. ) Dialogue: "That's a deal!", "Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes."
Finish the conversation with Commander Veldaban. Dialogue: "Yes, I will do this."
Talk to Blasidar the sculptor on the east side of Keldagrim, south of the kebab shop. Dialogue: "Yes, I will do this."
Talk to Vermundi, the silk trader in the eastern market. (Big building east side of river, silk icon) Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes."
Talk to the Librarian in the library, located at the north-east corner of West Keldagrim. Dialogue: "Do you know anything about King Alvis' clothes?"
Climb any bookcase to find a book on costumes known as the 'Scholars Guide to Dwarven Costumes'.

Use your coal and logs on the spinning machine next to Vermundi then light it with a tinderbox.

If you didn't bring the 3 Sapphires, they can be purchased from Hervi at the Gem stall just to the north of Vermundi.
While here, steal from the baker's or crafting stall for completion of a task in the Easy Fremennik Diary (optional)
Talk to Saro at the anvil south-west of the bank in West Keldagrim. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots."
Speak to Dromund in the house just north of the bank.
Take the left boot when he isn't looking.
Go outside behind his house and telegrab the right boot through the window when he isn't looking.

Talk to Santiri at the weapon shop in north-western West Keldagrim. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.", "Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue.", "Perhaps I can repair the axe?"
Use your 3 sapphires on the axe (now in your inventory) and talk to him again. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe."
If you have not completed The Knight's Sword Quest then you must speak to the librarian and then to Reldo in Varrock Library.

Talk to Thurgo at Mudskipper Point (), and give him an iron bar to repair the axe. Dialogue: "Something else.", "Can you help me with this ancient axe?", "Return to Keldagrim immediately." (Dialogue: "Can you help me with this ancient axe?", "Would you like a redberry pie?", "Can you help me with this ancient axe?", "Return to Keldagrim immediately." May need a redberry pie if Thurgo has not received one recently).
You will be given the option to immediately return to Keldagrim; do so. Dialogue: "Return to Keldagrim immediately."
Once in Blasidar's house, talk to Riki the sculptor's model to give him the clothes, axe and boots.
Talk to Blasidar. Watch the cutscene.

Go to the upper floor of the market and talk to the secretary of any company except the Red Axe. Dialogue: "Is there anything I can help you with?". Ensure you perform tasks only for the company you choose, as the progress for each is separate. Buy the ores from Ordan in the Blast Furnace to save time.
Offer to help them. The secretaries require you to retrieve ores (cannot be noted). Be sure to read the dialogue to know what ores you need or fill your inventory with about 5 of each.

A hidden scoring system determines your progress with a company; each ore delivery completed gives 20 points, while failing or refusing a task subtracts 2 points. Once you reach 75 points, you can deliver metal bars for the director for 12 points each; 100 points is required to progress through this section.
Talk to the director after making enough progress and complete a few tasks for them. Dialogue: "Do you have any more tasks for me?"

After enough tasks, the director asks whether you've considered joining their company or states that you don't need to be doing running errands for them anymore. Join the company. Dialogue: "I'd like to officially join your company."
Tell the director that Blasidar sent you, offer your support. Dialogue: "Blasidar the sculptor has sent me.", "I would support you.", "Yes! Long live the <company name>!"
Go back and talk to Commander Veldaban west of the bank, he will ask if you want to attend the meeting. You may choose not to.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Pray at the Ectofuntus 7 or more times and talk to the Ghost disciple to get enough ecto-tokens for the quest.
Talk to Velorina inside Port Phasmatys in the house just east of the gates to begin the quest. Dialogue: "Why, what is the matter?", "Yes, I do. It is a very sad story.", "Yes."
Talk to Necrovarus back at the Ectofuntus.
Talk to Velorina again. Dialogue: "Do you know where this woman can be found?"
A few steps east of Slayer master Mazchna in Canifis is a patch of nettles. Wear your gloves and pick at least five: the nettle water can easily boil over, especially at low cooking levels.
Combine the nettle with the bowl of water, and cook it over a fire (there is a dead tree just south-east of the slayer tower). Do not drink the tea.
Head north-west to the old crone's house by the water, just east of the Slayer Tower.
Talk to the old crone east next to the slayer tower with nettle tea in your inventory. Dialogue: "I'm here about Necrovarus."

Put the tea in the porcelain cup and add your bucket of milk to the tea, then talk to the old crone again. Dialogue: "I'm here about Necrovarus.", "You are doing so much for me - is there anything I can do for you?"
Repair the model ship by using the needle on it. This will use up the silk and a thread.
Head to the wrecked ship on the coast north-west of the Ectofuntus and directly north of the farming allotment.
Climb up a ladder to the ship deck. Then, climb another ladder to get to the ship quarterdeck.
Wait for the wind speed to drop to low, and search the mast multiple times to find out what colour the three components of the flag are.
Dye the model ship's flag the right colours, mixing dyes as needed (use the dye on the toy ship and select which part to dye).
Head down one level to the ship deck, talk to the Old man. Dialogue: "Is this your toy boat?"
Use the key on the closed chest inside the captain's quarters to receive the first map scrap.

Climb down to the lowest level of the ship and get ready to fight. Search the chests until you are attacked by a giant lobster (level 32). Kill it, then search the chest it came out of to get the second map scrap.
Climb back up the ladder and proceed to the north-west side of deck where there is a gangplank you can walk out onto some rocks.
Jump along the path of rocks. At the end, there will be another chest with the final map scrap. (Save some run energy as some rocks take 5% energy)
Fit all the map pieces together to get a completed treasure map.
Head back inside Port Phasmatys again, and go south-east onto the docks. Take the small rowing boat to Dragontooth Island which is south-east at the docks.
Once there, use the map to find the treasure starting at the statue (or use the image on the right to find it). Dig with your spade, and you will find the book of Haricanto.
Return to Port Phasmatys.
Talk to Ak-Haranu around the docks. Dialogue: "Okay, wait here - I'll get you your bow."
Talk to Robin in the inn. He'll challenge you to a game of Rune-Draw. Beat him four times (in total, does not need to be consecutive) so he owes you 100 coins.
He'll give you the signed oak bow to repay the debt.
Take it back to Ak-Haranu for the translation manual.
Ask the ghost innkeeper if he has any jobs for you. He'll give you a bedsheet. Dialogue: "Do you have any job I can do?", "Yes, I'd be delighted."
Use bucket of slime on the bedsheet to dye it (can be bought from trader crewmembers at the docks to the east) and Wear it.
Talk to Gravingas, the ghost activist protesting just inside the town's gate. He'll ask you for 10 signatures. Dialogue: "After hearing Velorina's story I will be happy to help out."

Ask ghost villagers around town for signatures with the bedsheet equipped. You can alternate between just two ghosts for all the signatures. If one asks you for ecto-tokens, you can ignore them and ask the other, or you can pay if you have tokens to spare.
With all 10 signatures, show the petition to Necrovarus.
Take the key Necrovarus drops and head upstairs. Use the key on the door and enter the room. Take his robes from the coffin.
Return to the old crone. Dialogue: "I'm here about Necrovarus."

Head back to the ectofuntus and talk to Necrovarus. Dialogue: "Let any ghost who so wishes pass on into the next world." Once you've spoken to Necrovarus, you will be able to enter Port Phasmatys freely.
Enter Port Phasmatys one last time and talk to Velorina.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Minigame Teleport to "Giants' Foundry"

Select the fitting mould Kovac described for the forte, blade and tip at the mould jig.
Speak to Kovac again. He will tell you to pour the metal.
Pour the metal from the crucible into the mould.

Get a bucket of water (grab a bucket from the pile of buckets and use it on the waterfall), and pour it on the sword. You can also use ice gloves for this step. Your hands must be free to pick up the preform.

Heat the preform to maximum by using it on the lava pool. The "Heat-preform" option will increase the heat by small increments, while the "Dunk-preform" option will heat it faster. The temperature should be red.

Hit the preform with the Trip Hammer repaired earlier, repeating until progress bar is onto the yellow section. Be sure to keep the temperature in the red while doing this, otherwise the quality of the sword will decrease. Using the Trip Hammer will cool the preform.
Cool the preform using the waterfall until its temperature is almost green. The "Cool-preform" option will cool the preform slowly, while the "Quench-preform" option cools is more quickly.
Use the preform on Grindstone repaired earlier, repeating until progress is onto green section. Be sure to watch the temperature as the Grindstone will heat the preform during use.
Cool the preform in the waterfall until its temperature is high green.
Use the preform on the Polishing Wheel, repeating until the sword is complete. The Polishing Wheel will cool the preform during use, so be sure to watch the temperature.
Speak to Kovac.
Congratulations, quest complete!

places.label: The trapdoor to the Lumbridge Castle cellar

steps: Follow Kazgar, who is through the hole in the wall under Lumbridge kitchen
Talk to Mistag at the Dorgeshuun mines to start the quest. Dialogue: "What is this favour?", "Yes."
Bring two sets of H.A.M. robes to Zanik in Lumbridge cellar. (Can be purchased from the G.E.) Dialogue: "Yes, I'm [player name]!", "Yes, I have two sets of robes!"
Zanik will follow you, if you lose her go back to the cellar. Talk to the townspeople with her following.
# Talk to the Cook
# Talk to the Duke
# Talk to Hans
# Talk to any Man or Woman (Zanik must engage in the conversation. Try another if she does not.)
# Talk to Bob
# Talk to Father Aereck
# Talk to Lumbridge Guide
# Walk near a goblin. Zanik will talk to one.
# Talk to the shopkeeper
Ask Zanik, "Have you seen enough of Lumbridge yet?" Dialogue: "Have you seen enough of Lumbridge yet?", "Yes"
Put on your set of H.A.M. robes, and go to the H.A.M. Hideout (west of the general store) and pick the lock to the entrance trapdoor.
Talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht south-east of the stage. Dialogue: "Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?", "That's good."
Wander around the south of the stage, Zanik will spot a trapdoor.
Pick the trapdoor and go down. You'll need Zanik to kill the guards in this room to continue:
#Walk west past the first guard and talk to him, then Zanik will shoot him.

#Squeeze through the crack in the wall. Wait for the guard in the central corridor to walk by, then squeeze through the next crack in the wall. Run west behind the guard by the door and talk to him, then Zanik will shoot him.
#When the guard in the corridor starts walking east, talk to Zanik and say "Now!", and Zanik will snipe him.

#Move to the east side of the central corridor but stop with Zanik as far east as possible without joining the eastern corridor (this can be easily done by moving into that square and then walking one square west but be careful not to walk into the Eastern corridor). Talk to Zanik again and tell her to wait. Then, run west, south then east to the end of the corridor So the north eastern guard sees you and walks towards you. Zanik will shoot him as he passes the central corridor.

#For the final guard, again position Zanik as far north on as you can without the guard seeing you. Tell her to wait here and then head to the opposite position (top of the east/west corridors). Walk northward, causing the guard to walk towards you and Zanik will shoot him.
Listen at the door. A senior guard will appear and arrest you.
Pick the lock to escape the cell, then climb up the ladder and leave the hideout to find Zanik, dead. Take her body.
Go to Juna in the Chasm of Tears.
Talk to Juna and collect 20 Tears of Guthix to start the cutscene. Remember to have both hands free. Dialogue: "Yes."
With your full H.A.M. robes and gear for the fight, return to the castle cellar and talk to Zanik. Dialogue: "Let's go!"
Go to the chicken farm near the water wheel (File:Dairy churn icon.png icon on the east side of the river) and go through the southern gate.
With both hands free, search one of the southern empty crates and Zanik will hide in it. Dialogue: "I don't know, what are you thinking?", "Good idea."
While wearing the full H.A.M. robes, climb down the nearby trapdoor, and head to the western room. You will see Sigmund (level 50) and three Senior Guards (level 22).

Kill the guards first, then Sigmund. He will use protection prayers, but will use only protect from missiles in the second phase. You can safespot the guards using Zanik, and you can safespot Sigmund using the boxes. Make sure Zanik hits Sigmund before you do. This way, you will be able to damage him.
Smash the nearby drilling machine, then head down the southern tunnel to the exit. A cutscene will appear.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: With one free inventory space, talk to Mosol Rei outside of Shilo Village. A gnome glider is nearby, as well as fairy ring . Dialogue: "Why do I need to run?", "Rashiliyia? Who is she?", "What can we do?", "I'll go to see the Shaman", "Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus."
Use the wampum belt on Trufitus, found in the most north-eastern house in Tai Bwo Wannai (quest icon on minimap). Fairy ring is nearby.

Follow the chat options once you've used the belt on him. Dialogue: "Mosol Rei said something about a legend?", "Do you know anything more about the temple?", "Tell me more.", "I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!", "Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help."

Head to the temple of Ah Za Rhoon south-west of the Shipyard and east of Shilo Village across the River Amja (the pile of rocks on the minimap). Use a gnome glider or Fairy ring , or walk there by crossing the wooden log to the east, then head south until you reach a mound of earth surrounded by rocks.
Use your spade on the mound of earth.
Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure, then use your rope on the fissure. You will lose the item.
Search the fissure () to climb down and follow the cave south until you reach the stream.
Search the cave-in at 2 to enter a new cave. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll wriggle through."
Search the loose rocks at 6 to find a tattered scroll. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them." Read the scroll.
Search the sacks at 7 to find a crumpled scroll. Read the scroll.
Search the ancient gallows at 8 to get the Zadimus corpse. Dialogue: "Yes, I may find something else on the corpse."
Teleport out, or head back to the first area via the Cave in at 2.
Head to the Tribal Statue near Trufitus' hut and bury the corpse.
With your bronze wire and chisel, head south-west to Cairn Isle, west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring . Climb the rocks () and then cross the bridge.
Search the well stacked rocks on the northern side of the island, and then enter the crevice, requiring (). If you can't get in the cave you didn't read the Tattered Scroll.

Head south and with at least 3 empty inventory spaces search the dolmen. If you had no space you'll have to return with charcoal and papyrus to get the notes. Do not drop the locating crystal or you will take 5-10 damage.
Use a chisel on the sword pommel to craft the bone beads.
Use bronze wire on the bone beads to create the Beads of the Dead necklace. You must read the Crumpled Scroll before you can create them.
Teleport out or climb up the rockslide nearby to escape the cave (may take up to 10 damage if you fail).
Prepare for the fight against Nazastarool. Crumble Undead is useful alongside Protect from Melee.
With your three regular bones, bone shard and chisel, head south-east from fairy ring to the north-eastern dot on the Karamja map above.
Search the unique bright green palm tree from the north side to find two doors.
Search the doors to find the keyhole.
Use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key.
Equip the Beads of the Dead then use the key on the doors.
Open the ancient gate (while wearing the Beads of the Dead necklace), then climb down the rocks.
Run west, south, then south-west through the dungeon to reach a pair of doors.
Use (don't bury) 3 regular bones on the doors (can kill skeletons, not zombies for the bones if you forgot).
Search the dolmen, then defeat Nazastarool in his 3 forms. If you click away from the dialogue at the end of each form, click on the dolmen again to resume the other phases.
Take the Rashiliyia corpse.
Return to Cairn Isle (fairy ring ).
Go through the well-stacked rocks.
Use the corpse on the dolmen.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: To begin speak to Elena in East Ardougne (directly west of shortcut log). Dialogue: "I'll try to retrieve it for you."

Stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet.

With 3 empty inventory spaces, return to Elena and give her the distillator (via Ardougne Teleport, Skills necklace teleport to the Fishing Guild, over the wall by Kilron, or via the sewers from the Plague City quest).

Travel to the fenced area to the south-east of the bank (south-eastern Varrock). The guard will search you, but you will be able to pass freely with the plague sample and touch paper in your inventory.

Go to the Dancing Donkey Inn.
Talk to Hops, Da Vinci and Chancy to get the vials back. Make sure you have the free inventory space.
With your Priest gown equipped head to Guidor's house in the south-east of the fenced area.
Speak to Guidor, tell him Elena has sent a sample that needs to be processed. Dialogue: "I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague."

Go to the of Ardougne Castle and speak to King Lathas. Dialogue: "I don't understand..."
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Effigy south of East Ardougne (south-west of fairy ring , Ardougne cloak monastery teleport and walk east, or minigame teleport to Fishing Trawler and walk north) to begin the quest. Dialogue: "Sure, why not."

steps: Speak to Guildmaster Apatura in the Hunters' Guild. Dialogue: "Can I help you with anything?"
Go down the stairs in the big tree in the middle of Hunters' Guild.
Speak to Guild Scribe Verity behind the bar.
Talk to Guild Hunter Wolf (Master) just west of the bar to get a toy mouse.
Wind up the toy mouse and then use it on Guild Hunter Kiko to distract him.
Check Kiko's cat bed.
Return to Wolf and talk to her again.
Buy a box trap from Imia's Supplies if you do not have one. Pick up the needle spawn in the fur shop for later use.
Go back up the stairs and head south-east from the guild towards the mine to find Guild Hunter Fox laying down. He can be found south-east of the mining symbol (south-west of Fairy Ring )
Talk to Fox.
Take a leaf from the leafy bush. The bush is south-west of him and browner than the other bushes.
Go east to the Locus Oasis and pick from the rough-looking bush for a second leaf. The bush is south of the hunter symbol on the map, on the west coast of the oasis.
While here, catch two Embertailed jerboa using a box trap for their tails.
Use the Jerboa tail on the leaves to create Makeshift poultice.
Return to Fox and talk to him again.
Head to Atza, who is in one of the buildings just east of the southern gate of Civitas illa Fortis (west of the pub). Talk to her.
Set-up the pile of equipment in the middle of the room. (A hammer is available in the house to the north.)
Talk to Atza to get the trimmed fur.
Return to Fox. He will give you a report for the guild.
Return to Guild Scribe Verity, down the stairs in the Hunter Guild, and give her the report.
Use the remaining jerboa tail on the cat bed to fix it.
Head back upstairs, and talk to Guildmaster Apatura.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Brundt in the longhall to start the quest. (Fairy ring and run south-west to Rellekka) Dialogue: "Do you have any quests?", "Yes, I am interested.", "I want to become a Fremennik!", or Dialogue: "Ask about anything else.", "Do you have any quests?", "Yes, I am interested.", "I want to become a Fremennik!" if started or finished Mountain Daughter
The trials may be done in any order, however this quick guide will show you the fastest order.
Talk to Manni the Reveller while in the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Take the keg of beer and challenge Manni to a drinking contest. You will lose. Dialogue: "Yes"
If you did not bring a beer, grab the beer tankard now.
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman outside, near the entrance of the longhall, to obtain the Hunters' Talisman. Dialogue: "What's a Draugen?", "Yes"
Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Talk to Olaf again. Dialogue: "I don't need a reminder"
To get a lyre, either make it yourself (Requires and 6 free inventory spaces) or kill Lanzig (1/17 drop rate). Killing lanzig takes longer on average. You must enchant it either way.
Teleport to Camelot or walk to Seers' Village.
If you are making the lyre yourself:
Go to the Seers' Village pub and talk to the Poison Salesman to buy a low alcohol keg for 250 coins. Dialogue: "Talk about the Fremennik Trials", "Yes"
Buy a regular beer if you forgot to take a beer tankard. Dialogue: "Beer please."
Use a Rellekka house teleport to return, or simply walk back. If walking, left-click on your talisman to check if The Draugen is nearby on your way. If so, kill him.
Use the beer, or beer tankard, on the council workman by the bridge south of Rellekka to obtain strange object.
Go north across the bridge, then walk a bit west until you see a small narrow path heading south into the water. (The large rib cage sticking out of the water on the left side of the bridge)
Use your raw shark/manta ray/sea turtle on the strange altar to enchant your lyre.
Follow your talisman by left-clicking on it and kill The Draugen now if you haven't already. Appears as a grey butterfly before locating the correct tile.
Once done, head back into Rellekka and talk to Sigli at the entrance.
Head to the outside of the longhall to the pipe on the eastern wall. Use a tinderbox on your strange object and use the lit strange object on the pipe.
Enter the north-eastern back door of the longhall, walk onto the stage, and play your enchanted lyre.
Exit the back door, enter the main long hall, and take a keg of beer off the table.
Use your low alcohol keg on the keg of beer.
Challenge Manni to a drinking contest again. Dialogue: "Yes"
Talk to Sigmund The Merchant in the market west of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Talk to the Sailor on the docks to the north-west. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"

steps: Climb down the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub.
Search the wall and enter the cave entrance just south-east.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz. Dialogue: "I want to join your organisation."
Talk to Florin through the gate to Burgh de Rott.
Put a piece of food into the open chest, then open the gate.
Talk to Razvan near the pub. Dialogue: "Are there any 'out of the way' places in here?"
Enter the pub, climb over the broken wall, then use your pickaxe on the rubble blocking the trapdoor.
Climb down and mine the rest of the rubble. Anything you drop in the basement will be lost upon leaving.
Use your spade on the remnants to fill the buckets. There is enough here to fill five buckets.
When finished, use the buckets of rubble on the rubble pile outside the pub.
Talk to Razvan again. Dialogue: "I'd like to help fix up the town."
Talk to Aurel in the general store to the north-east. Dialogue: "I'd like to help fix up the town."
Climb up the ladder right outside.
Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the broken roof of the store.
Climb back down and Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall of the general store.
Talk to Aurel again to get a crate. Dialogue: "What should I do now?"
Add 10 bronze axes, 10 raw mackerels or 10 snails (depending on what is asked), and 3 tinderboxes to the crate.
Talk to Aurel.
Talk to Cornelius in the bank. Dialogue: "What should I do now?"
Use a hammer with 2 planks, 1 swamp paste, and 8 nails on the broken bank booth
Use a hammer with 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall outside.
Talk to Cornelius to recruit him. Dialogue:
Talk to Razvan. Dialogue: "What should I do now?"
Repair the furnace to the south-east. Use your steel bars, then coal, then tinderbox on the furnace.
Talk to Gadderanks in the general store.
Talk to the Vampyre Juvinate in the store.
Talk to Wiskit.
Kill the two juvinates and then Gadderanks (you'll need a silver weapon or Wolfbane dagger or Efaritay's aid to damage them).
Talk to Gadderanks.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the hideout where the quest started. (The room under the Canifis pub)
Talk to Polmafi Ferdygris.
Talk to Ivan Strom to go on a simplified version of Temple Trekking and take either the short or long route. (you can't bring a pet - it must be banked!)
Kill the Vampyre Juvinates before they can kill Ivan Strom.

After you're done escorting Ivan, talk to Drezel in the underground temple for a key. Dialogue: "Veliaf told me about Ivandis.", "Is there somewhere that I might get more information about Ivandis?", "The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!"
Use the key on the keyhole on the eastern wall and climb down the trapdoor.
Search the bookcases in the hidden room until you find The sleeping seven (The title of the book at the top when reading it is "The Sleeping Seven"). Read it.
Return to the room under the Canifis pub, then go to the blockaded cave entrance just south-east of the wall.
Use a hammer on the wooden boards and enter the cave.
Congratulations, quest complete!
