steps: Inspect Skrach Uglogwee in the Lumbridge Castle dining room. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy."
Talk to Rantz in the Feldip Hills (fairy ring AKS, then east). Dialogue: "I'm trying to free Skrach, can you help?", "Ok, I'll do it."
Go south-east to the coast and talk to Rantz again. Dialogue: "Ok, here I am... I guess this is the watery place? What now?"
Use your axe on the fallen tree twice, then talk to Rantz again. Dialogue: "Ok, the boat's ready, now tell me how to get a Jubbly?"
Board the ogre boat to Karamja and find the tree with an arrow in it on the west coast, west of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Light a fire next to the tree, use your iron spit on the raw chompy, then cook it on the fire.
Board the ogre boat back and talk to Rantz on the coast. Dialogue: "Ok, now tell me how to get Jubbly!"
Fill your ogre bellows at the swamp bubbles and inflate a toad in the nearby swamp.
Mine a rock from the pile of rocks east of Rantz's cave.
Use the ogre bellows on the bloated toad with a ball of wool in your inventory to make a balloon toad.
Drop the balloon toad in the dark area south of Rantz's cave and kill the level 9 Jubbly with your ogre bow and ogre arrows.
Pluck the Jubbly, pick up the raw jubbly and cook it on Rantz's spit-roast. If you burn it, make another balloon toad.
Give the cooked jubbly to Skrach Uglogwee in Lumbridge Castle to finish.

Use an iron spit on a chompy.
Light a fire on Karamja's west coast. Afterwards, use your skewered chompy on it.

Blow up a toad with the bellows.

Use the bellows on your toad with a ball of wool in your inventory.
Drop the balloon toad in the dark area south of Rantz's cave and wait for a Jubbly to arrive.
steps.s: Drop the balloon toad south of Rantz's cave and wait for a Jubbly.

steps: Talk to Timfraku upstairs in the western hut north of Tai Bwo Wannai. Dialogue: "I am a wandering wayfarer.", "Trufitus sent me.", "So far??", "Yes".
With your small fishing net, catch at least 23 raw karambwanji at the fishing spots just south of Tai Bwo Wannai.

Talk to Lubufu at the fishing spots south of the Brimhaven house portal. Dialogue: "I wasn't going anywhere...", then "Talk about him...", "What do you do?", "How old are you?", "I could help collect the bait.", "You sound like you could do with the help."
Talk to him again to give him 20 raw karambwanji, then again: "What do you use to catch Karambwan?", "What do you do with your Karambwan?", and accept his offer to receive a karambwan vessel.
Drop the vessel and ask Lubufu for another ("Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel."), then pick up the first, so that you have two.
Slice a banana with your knife and use the sliced banana on the Karamjan rum (bought from Zembo in Musa Point for 30 coins).
Light a fire with logs and a tinderbox, use the jogre bones on it and wait for the fire to go out; pick up the burnt jogre bones.
Use the pestle and mortar on one raw karambwanji to make karambwanji paste, and use the paste on the burnt jogre bones.
Cook the pasty jogre bones on a fire to make marinated jogre bones. Do not bury them.
Cook the raw karambwan into a poison karambwan, grind it with the pestle and mortar and use the karambwan paste on your iron spear.
Go to Tiadeche, north-east of fairy ring DKP, and pick up the seaweed nearby. Talk to him.
Use a raw karambwanji on a karambwan vessel, then use the baited vessel on Tiadeche. Dialogue: "Yes".
Go to Tamayu at the mine north-east of fairy ring CKR. Talk to him twice and watch the cutscene. Dialogue: "When will you succeed?", "Yes".
Use the agility potion(4) and your karambwan-poisoned spear on Tamayu; make sure he takes both.
Talk to him again and watch him kill the Shaikahan. Dialogue: "Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan."
Kill a nearby level 3 monkey with Wind Strike and pick up its corpse; melee does no damage to it.
Use the corpse on Tamayu to get a monkey skin, and use the seaweed on the skin to make a seaweed sandwich.
Go to Cairn Isle, west of fairy ring CKR, climb the rocks and cross the bridge. Talk to Tinsay and give him the banana rum, seaweed sandwich and marinated jogre bones. Dialogue: "Yes."
Use your remaining karambwan vessel, empty or baited, on Tinsay to receive a crafting manual.
Return to Tiadeche near fairy ring DKP, talk to him, then use the manual on him.
Return to Timfraku and talk to him to complete the quest. Dialogue: "Oh it was nothing really."

Talk to each brother in his house in southern Tai Bwo Wannai for the extra rewards: Tiadeche 5,000 Fishing XP, Tinsay 5,000 Cooking XP and karambwan cooking, Tamayu 2,500 Attack and 2,500 Strength XP and a karambwan-poisoned rune spear.

steps.s: Net at least 23 raw karambwanji south of Tai Bwo Wannai.

steps.t: Go to Brimhaven and talk to Lubufu. You have to talk to him multiple times. You'll need to ask him twice about what he does, then talk to him to give him the karambwanji.
steps.s: Talk to Lubufu in Brimhaven and give him 20 karambwanji.

steps.t: Get a Vessel from Lubufu by asking what he uses to catch them multiple times. Drop it, and talk to him go get another, then pick up the one you dropped. You can get as many as you want but you need 2 to complete this quest.
steps.s: Drop Lubufu's vessel and ask him for another; you need 2 vessels.

Use a karambwanji on a karambwan Vessel to fill it.

Slice a banana with a knife. You can get a banana from one of the trees in the plantation.
steps.s: Slice a banana with a knife; bananas grow in the plantation.

steps.t: Add banana slices to the karamjan rum to make Karamjan rum with banana slices.
steps.s: Add the banana slices to the Karamjan rum.

steps.t: Talk to Tiadeche in east Karamja, near the fairy ring DKP. You can teleport off Karamja; the Karamjan rum with banana will not break.
steps.s: Talk to Tiadeche in east Karamja, near fairy ring DKP.

steps.t: Use a filled vessel on Tiadeche. Make sure to finish the dialogue with him and accept the karambwan he offers!
steps.s: Use a filled vessel on Tiadeche and accept the karambwan he offers.

steps.t: Talk to Tiadeche more.
Pickup some seaweed from Karamja's coast.
Get some jogre bones. You can kill the jogres south of Tiadeche.
Pickup the jogre bones.
Use a tinderbox on the jogre bones to set them on fire.
Wait for the bones to burn, then pick them up.
Use a pestle and mortar on a karambwanji.
Use the karambwanji paste on the burnt jogre bones.
Fish raw Karambwan next to Tiadeche with a loaded vessel or buy them from the GE.

steps.t: Use the bones on a fire. You can either make one yourself, or use them on the fire south of Tai Bwo Wannai.
steps.s: Use the pasty jogre bones on a fire to marinate them.

steps.t: Cook the karambwan for a poison karambwan. Note you may fail this and need to try again.
steps.s: Cook the raw karambwan into a poison karambwan; it can fail.

steps.t: Use a pestle and mortar on a poison karambwan.
Use the karambwan paste on a iron or better spear.
Talk to Tamayu, he is located north of Shilo Village near the mining sign on the map, after watching him use your tinder box on your jogre bones and pick up the burnt jogre bones.
steps.s: Talk to Tamayu north of Shilo Village, by the mining sign.

steps.t: Use an agility potion (4) on Tamayu.
Use a poisoned spear on Tamayu.
Go on a hunt with Tamayu.
Kill a monkey to get its corpse, there are plenty of monkeys around Karamja and you will need either magic or range to kill one.

steps.t: Pickup the monkey corpse.

steps.s: Talk to Tinsay on Cairn Isle (ring CKR) and give what he asks for.

steps.t: Use the vessel on Tinsay.
Go back to Tiadeche located north of fairy ring DKP and use the crafting manual on him.
steps.s: Go back to Tiadeche near fairy ring DKP and use the manual on him.

steps.t: Go to Timfraku's house to finish the quest.
Talk to Timfraku to end the quest; the option chosen does not matter. Then talk to each brother for his reward and the ability to cook karambwans.

steps: Talk to Father Reen outside Al Kharid bank. Dialogue: "That's me!"
Travel to the Ruins of Uzer: take the magic carpet south of Al Kharid (Shantay pass needed), or use fairy ring DLQ and go north-east.
Talk to Father Badden near the ruin entrance. Dialogue: "Reen sent me.", "So what do you want me to do?", "How can I do that?" Be sure to have Silverlight in your inventory.

Pick 3 black mushrooms beside the staircase. Use one on Silverlight to dye it black; grind the others with the pestle and mortar and a vial each into 2 black dyes, and dye your desert shirt and desert robe.
Go down the stairs and grab a copy of the Strange implement in the north-west corner of the ruin.
Wearing the black desert shirt, black desert robe, black cape and the dyed Silverlight, talk to Evil Dave in the dungeon. Dialogue: "I want to join your group.", "I'm evil!"
Talk to Denath on the other side of the portal. Dialogue: "What do I have to do?"
Talk to Jennifer to get a demonic sigil mould. Dialogue: "Do you have the demonic sigil mould?"
Talk to Matthew. Dialogue: "Do you know what happened to Josef?"
Go to any furnace and smelt a demonic sigil (use silver bar on furnace and select 'demonic sigil').
Your black outfit can now be discarded and replaced with combat gear (keep Silverlight with you).
Head back to Uzer and talk to the clay golem outside about last night. Dialogue: "Did you see anything happen last night?"
Search the nearby kilns for a book (there are four kilns – the last two are on the east side of the ruin, and by the magic carpet).
Read the book, and take it to Matthew on the other side of the portal

Go north and talk to Denath. Dialogue: "I forgot the incantation." (or Dialogue: "I forgot the incantation." during the ritual). Write down the incantation he tells you as it is used twice during the quest.
Complete the circle and click the sigil in your inventory to chant the incantation (unequip the Silverlight if nothing happens).
Take the demonic sigil Denath dropped on the floor. If you do not, you will have to create another demonic sigil.
Enter the portal to exit the room and take Tanya's sigil.
Tell Evil Dave to return to the lair Dialogue: "You've got to get back to the throne room!" – you should have 4 sigils now.
Talk to Father Badden outside.
Convince Father Reen to join the ritual. Dialogue: "Oh, don't be so simple-minded!"
Talk to the golem, he will refuse to help. Dialogue: "I could just reprogram you again."
Use the Strange implement on the golem to reprogram him.
Talk to the golem again to make him enter the dungeon.
Talk to Matthew to start the incantation, say it backwards. Dialogue: "Yes"
Kill Agrith Naar (level 100) with any weapon, but the final blow must be with Silverlight. The demon heals if you run away while the final blow is being dealt.
Unequip Silverlight.
Choose your reward to finish the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to King Lathas on the 1st floor of Ardougne Castle. Dialogue: "I am. What's our plan?", "Yes."
Talk to Koftik in the westernmost part of West Ardougne next to the cave. Dialogue: "I'll take my chances."
Enter the cave and run south at the first junction.
Talk to Koftik for a cloth. Use it on an arrow, then use your tinderbox on it or use the arrow on the fire on the ground.
Go north to the gated area.
Equip your bow and fire arrow (be sure to light the arrow with your tinderbox), then shoot the guide rope attached to the bridge.
Once across the bridge, take the plank in the north room (if you did not bring one).
Continue through the cave until you reach a section with water and a pit. Ignore the water, use a rope on the rock above the pit. If you fail, you will lose your rope.
Continue through the cave until you reach a large grid.
Walk across the grid and use trial and error to find your path. You will fall through some of the tiles. Some paths are not possible, see the full guide for solving this optimally.
Pull the lever next to the gate.

You can now pray Rapid Heal for the duration of this step (there is an altar up ahead). Run west past the zombie camp, there will be five sets of odd markings along the walls of the corridor (You must attempt to disable the wall traps or walk past them).
You will reach an altar, take the north path using the plank on the flat rocks.
Take the orb and walk back to the altar.
Take the north-west path with the ogres and blessed spiders. Take the orb.
Take the centre-most west path, traversing the flat rocks using the plank. Take the orb.
Take the final path, do not pick up the orb, but search the rock beneath instead and disarm the trap to get the orb.
Return to the zombie camp to the east.
Use the 4 orbs on the furnace.
Return to the altar, turn off Rapid Heal/pray at altar and climb down the well.
Optional: Search the two stacked crates in the room you landed in to find 2 salmon and 2 meat pies.
Go west and picklock the south-east slave cage gate.
Use your spade on the loose mud.
Go west and cross the ledge.
If you have 50 thieving, take the short cut - avoid the bubbles!
If you lack 50 thieving, cross the stone bridge maze to get to the other side.
Squeeze-through the pipe.
Search the unicorn cage.
Walk through the path south of the cage and use the piece of railing on the boulder above the unicorn.
Search the cage again to get the Unicorn horn. You can drop the piece of railing.
Pass-through the tunnel and follow the cave until you reach the 3 knights.
Kill the 3 knights, Sir Jerro, Sir Carl and Sir Harry (level 62 paladins), and take their badges.
Continue forward, using your plank on either flat rock, until you see a well.
Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
Open the door.
Run south as far as you can (see map), and descend into the cave (yellow dot on map).
Talk to Niloof the dwarf, you will also receive 2 meat pies and a meat pizza.
Talk to Klank the dwarf. Dialogue: (Make sure to have one inventory slot available to receive his gauntlets.)
Go upstairs and search the Witch's window from outside her house (Cross the broken bridge north-east of the house. Use the map pictured to find her).
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Ellamaria at the garden east of the palace. Dialogue: "Yes."
Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village with the Ring of Charos. Dialogue: "Queen Ellamaria has sent me to seek your guidance."
Quiz answers:
See to the survival of your crops as you see fit. It is strongly recommended to compost all patches as the gardeners will refuse to watch over them.
Always have on you: A rake, seed dibber, spade, secateurs, watering can, gardening trowel, and Ring of Charos(a).

Talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys, wearing the Ring of charos. Dialogue: "Do you have any orchid seeds to spare?", then choose every [Charm] option, ending with "That's a deal - I'll grow a patch of onions for you."
Grow onions (takes 40 minutes, planting in both patches reduce chance of failure).
Once grown, talk to Lyra for the orchid seeds.

Talk to Kragen north of East Ardougne. Dialogue: "Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?", "[Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.", "[Charm] I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.", "[Charm] So what ails you, my friend?", "[Charm] Well, is there anything I can do for you?", "[Charm] So what can I do for you?", "That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready."

Once grown, talk to Kragen for the snowdrop seeds.

Ah, just what I wanted to hear...", "Okay, I'll grow you some marigolds."
Grow marigolds in the patch (takes 20 minutes).
Once grown, give them to Elstan for the delphinium seeds.

Talk to Dantaera in Catherby. Dialogue: "Do you know how I could grow a White Tree?", "[Charm] I think that there is something that you are not telling me.", "[Charm] A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself.", "[Charm] Unless you allow me to do this she will die anyway."
Travel to Ice Mountain.
Use secateurs on the White Tree located on the northern part of the Ice Mountain to get the white tree shoot.
Put the cutting in your plant pot and water it.
Talk to Brother Althric at the Edgeville Monastery. Dialogue: "[Charm] These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen."
Run over to Edgeville and throw the Ring of Charos(a) down the well.
Take 4 seeds from the red, pink, and white roses.
Retrieve your ring with the fishing rod.
Talk to Bernald in Burthorpe. Dialogue: "[Charm] But it is the only way that these vines will be cured.", "I accept the deal."
Use 1 plant cure on the vines.
Talk to Bernald again.
Talk to Alain by the Taverley tree patch. Dialogue: "I need to ask you about strong plant cures.", "Are you sure there's nothing you can suggest?"
Use a hammer or chisel on the rune/pure essence to get rune shards.
Use a pestle and mortar on the rune shards to get rune dust.
Use the rune dust on the other plant cure to get the strong plant cure, then use it on the vines.
Talk to Bernald to get the vine seeds.
Talk to Ellamaria, ask about the statues to get a trolley. Dialogue: "How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?"
Use the trolley on the statue of a king.
Push the trolley east over the bridge.
Place the statue on the eastern plinth in the garden.
Use the trolley on the Saradomin statue.
Push the trolley north through the gate.
Watch the cutscene.
Place the statue on the southern plinth in the garden.
Return to Ellamaria's garden and fill the 2 plant pots with compost.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.t: Talk to Ellamaria east of Varrock Castle.
Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.
Talk to Elstan north west of Draynor Village.
Plant a marigold near to Elstan.
Talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys.
Plant onions in a patch near Lyra. Plant in both for the best chance of one not dying.
steps.s: Plant onions in both patches near Lyra, so at least one survives.

steps.t: Talk to Kragen northeast of Ardougne.
Plant cabbage seeds in the patches near Kragen. Plant in both to be safe.
steps.s: Plant cabbage seeds in both patches near Kragen, to be safe.

steps.t: Talk to Dantaera north of Catherby.
Use secateurs on the white tree on top of Ice Mountain.
Use the shoot on a plant pot.
Water the white tree shoot.
Talk to Brother Althric in the Edgeville Monastery.
Use the Ring of charos(a) on the well in Edgeville.
Take some seeds from the white roses.
Take some seeds from the pink roses.
Take some seeds from the red roses.
Use a fishing rod on the well in Edgeville to retrieve the ring of charos. This can take a few attempts.
steps.s: Use a fishing rod on the Edgeville well to fish out the ring.

steps.t: Talk to Bernald in Burthorpe.
Use plant cure on Bernald's grapevines.
Talk to Alain in Taverley with your ring of charos UNEQUIPPED.
Use a hammer on some essence.
Use a pestle and mortar on the essence shards.
Use the rune dust on some plant cure.
Use the enhanced plant cure on Bernald's grapevines.
Talk to Bernald for his seeds.
Harvest marigolds from the Falador Allotment patches. If yours died, you'll need to grow some more there.
steps.s: Harvest marigolds from the Falador allotment; replant if they died.

steps.t: Give Elstan a marigold for his seeds.
Wait for your onions to finish growing. If they died you'll need to plant more in Lyra's patches.
steps.s: Wait for the onions to grow; replant in Lyra's patches if they died.

steps.t: Talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys again for her seeds.
Wait for your cabbages to finish growing. If they died you'll need to plant more in Kragen's patches.
steps.s: Wait for the cabbages to grow; replant in Kragen's if they died.

steps.t: Talk to Kragen northeast of Ardougne for his seeds.
Plant the rose seeds.
Plant the rose seeds.
Plant the rose seeds.
Plant the delphinum seeds.
Plant the white tree.
Plant snowdrops in the east patch.
Plant the vine seeds.
Plant the yellow orchids in the marked plantpot.
Plant the pink orchids in the marked plantpot.
Fill the plantpots in Ellamaria's garden with compost.
Fill the plantpots in Ellamaria's garden with compost.
Talk to Ellamaria for a trolley.
Use a trolley on the king statue outside Lumbridge Castle.
Push the trolley across the River Lum, then to the marked plinth in the garden. Right-click 'place' the statue when it's next to the plinth.
steps.s: Push the trolley across the River Lum to the garden plinth; place it.

steps.t: Use the trolley on the statue of Saradomin in Falador.
Push the trolley out of Falador, then to the marked plinth in the garden. Right-click 'place' the statue when it's next to the plinth.
steps.s: Push the trolley out of Falador to the garden plinth; place it.

steps.t: Talk to Ellamaria once everything's finished growing.
Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle, watch the cutscene, then finish the dialog with Ellamaria to finish the quest!
steps.s: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle, then finish with Ellamaria.

steps: Talk to King Lathas in Ardougne Castle. Dialogue: "I assume you have a plan?", "Yes."
Travel through the Underground Pass, entering on the far west side of West Ardougne. Refer to Underground Pass/Quick guide if you become stuck.
Travel south to Iban's Temple and enter the well (optional: talk to Koftik for some free food).
Exit the cave to the west.
Run west through the forest, then talk to Idris when he spawns (this may take a little while).
Follow the map to Lord Iorwerth.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth.
Follow the map to the Elf Tracker.
Talk to the Elf Tracker.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth again. (You must have an open space in your inventory to receive the Crystal Pendant.)
Talk to the Elf Tracker again.
Click to follow the tracks, they are west of the tracker, at the north-west corner of the blue mushrooms.
Talk to the Elf Tracker.
Climb through the dense forest, kill the level 110 Tyras guard that spawns, with Fire Bolt from a safespot.
Go north, pass tripwire and go through more dense forest.
Run west then south through more dense forest, talk to General Hining in the camp.
Take at least 2 barrels. 3 is highly recommended in case you fail distillation of coal tar in upcoming steps. The second barrel is needed for Mourning's End Part I.
Go back to the Elf Tracker and use 2-3 of your barrels on the tar just south of him to obtain barrel of coal tar.
Get a piece of sulphur from right next to where you got the tar.

Talk to Lord Iorwerth with one empty inventory slot. Players wishing to keep their Crystal pendant should drop it each time before talking to Lord Iorwerth (or King Lathas) for the rest of the quest. Banking it will not keep it safe!
Read the book and keep it in your inventory.

Talk to Lord Iorwerth about each item (sulphur, naptha, quicklime, barrel, and fuse). Dialogue: "I need some quicklime.", "I need some sulphur.", "I need some naphtha.", "I need a barrel.", "I need a fuse.", "That's all thanks."
If you need limestone, make sure you have your pickaxe. Head east through the Dense forest, jump over the leaves, then into the mine. Beware of Level 88 dire wolves.
Go back to where you got the barrels so you can use the small furnace, or teleport to a bank near a furnace (Falador, Edgeville, etc)
Use limestone on any furnace (make sure gloves are equipped or you will take damage.)
With a pot in your inventory, use your pestle and mortar on the quicklime. If you do this incorrectly, you will need to repeat the previous step with a new limestone.
Use your pestle and mortar on the sulphur.
If you have not already created a strip of cloth, use four balls of wool on the loom in the farm south of Falador or near the house portal in the Hosidius area to make one.
The coal from your bank can be noted, but you will need to un-note it using Phials in the nearby general store once you get there.
Talk to the chemist Dialogue: "Your quest." in Rimmington. Make sure you have the book in your inventory. (If you don't, the Quest Journal will not update!)

Un-note your coal and then use your barrel of coal tar on the fractionalising still outside. All 20 coal should be in the inventory at once, as leaving the interface for the still will reset all process towards making the naphtha.
Read this whole section first before you distill! When you are ready, operate the still:
Once the green bar is full you may exit out of the interface and automatically receive the barrel of naphtha
Make a second barrel of naphtha for Mourning's End Part I. No sulphur or quicklime needed to be added to the second barrel.
Use the pot of quicklime and ground sulphur on the barrel of naphtha to make a barrel bomb (unfused).
Use the strip of cloth on the barrel bomb (unfused) to make a barrel bomb.
Go through the Underground Pass once more. Bringing summer pies this time is highly recommended because you are now carrying a very heavy barrel bomb.
If you did not bring your own cooked rabbit, kill one north-west of the Elf Tracker and cook it. If you forgot an axe, there is a fire in the Iorwerth Camp.
Head to the catapult, north of the Tyras Camp.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Bank every item, worn ones too: the test rooms allow no items, food or potions.
Speak to Sir Amik Varze on the 2nd floor of the western section of the White Knights' Castle. Dialogue: "Yes please".
Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park to begin the test. Dialogue: "Yes, let's go!".
5 of the following 7 rooms come in a random order; Sir Kuam's fight with Sir Leye is always one of them. A Hardcore Ironman who dies to him loses that status.
Sir Kuam Ferentse: take the steel warhammer in the room and defeat Sir Leye (level 20, max hit 3); prayer is allowed, food is not.
Lady Table: look at the statues for about 10 seconds, then pick the one that was added (its colour and weapon are new).
Sir Ren Itchood: ask for the clue to the door; the code is the first letter of each sentence.
Sir Tinley: left-click him, finish the conversation, then press nothing until he speaks to you again.
Sir Spishyus: cross with the chicken; bring the grain and take the chicken back; bring the fox; then fetch the chicken. Unequip each one on the far side.
Ms. Hynn Terprett: answer her riddle: Fed to wolves, Bucket A (32 degrees), 0, or Three False.

Miss Cheevers: take the vials from the shelves, the knife, cake tin and gypsum, and use the spade, cupric sulfate and a vial on the first door; on the second, mix the vial, gypsum and tin ore powders in the tin, cool it, heat it on the bunsen burner and cut the key free.
Congratulations, quest complete!

items.where: The Ice Queen drops them under White Wolf Mountain; wear them to pick up the fire feather.

steps: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild in Burthorpe. Dialogue: "I'm a hero, may I apply to join?", "I'll start looking for all those things then."
Talk to Gerrant, the fishing shop owner in Port Sarim about lava eels. Dialogue: "I want to find out how to catch a lava eel." He'll give you a bottle of blamish snail slime.
Use the blamish snail slime on your harralander potion (unf) to create blamish oil.
Buy a fishing rod and some bait if you do not have them.
Right-click to use the oil on your fishing rod.
Travel to the Taverley Dungeon.
To obtain a dusty key:
Enter the area with the blue dragons, either by using your key on the locked door or take the agility shortcut.
Run to the southernmost lava pool.
Catch a lava eel. You only need one, as they cannot be burned. (Catch extra in case you accidentally eat it.)
Cook the eel on a range or fire.
Go to south-west Varrock and talk to Katrine in the Black Arm gang headquarters. Dialogue: "Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?"
Go to Brimhaven, the building directly south of the agility arena entrance.
Gang password: Four leaved clover
Talk to Trobert. Dialogue: "So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?", "I volunteer to undertake that mission!"
Equip your Black armour.
Enter the large mansion in the north-west part of town.
Talk to Grip to receive a Miscellaneous key. If you already have a key in your bank, Grip will not give you another one. Dialogue: "So what do my duties involve?", "Anything I can do now?"
Go to Varrock and talk to Straven in the Phoenix hideout
Gang password: Gherkin
Inside Brimhaven food shop, talk to Alfonse the Waiter about gherkins Dialogue: "Do you sell Gherkins?"
Go through the door, talk to Charlie Dialogue: "I'm looking for a gherkin...", "I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks."
Enter the secret wall panel by the range, through the yard, into the side door, then use the key on the north door
Enter the room north of the entrance and search the cupboard Dialogue: "He won't notice me having a quick look."
Grip will then come into the room. Close the door behind him
Take Grip's key
Go to the north-west part of the building, use the key on the door
Take 2 candlesticks from the chest
Give your partner 1 candlestick
Take your candlestick back to Katrine to receive the Thieves' armband Dialogue: "I have a candlestick now."
Trade your partner for a candlestick
Take your candlestick back to Straven to receive the Thieves' armband Dialogue: "I have a candlestick now."
To obtain the ice gloves:
Equip the ice gloves.
Travel to Entrana.
Kill the Firebird near the Law Altar, take the fire feather.
Take the feather, eel, and armband to Achietties.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.t: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild, south of Burthorpe. She wants a cooked lava eel, a fire feather and your gang's thieves' armband.
steps.s: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild.

steps.t: You need an oily rod: talk to Gerrant in Port Sarim for some blamish snail slime.
steps.s: Talk to Gerrant in Port Sarim for blamish snail slime.

steps.t: Combine the harralander potion (unf) with the blamish snail slime.
Use the Blamish oil on your fishing rod.
Go through Taverley Dungeon to the Black Knights' base and kill the Jailer in its east side for a jail key.
steps.s: Kill the Jailer in the Black Knights' base for a jail key.

steps.t: Use the jail key on the south door and talk to Velrak for a dusty key.
Enter the gate to the deeper Taverley dungeon.
Squeeze through the obstacle pipe.
Fish a lava eel from the lava south of the blue dragons.
Cook the Lava Eel at a range. You cannot fail this.
Go to White Wolf Mountain and mine the rockslide in its northern part.
steps.s: Mine the rockslide in the north of White Wolf Mountain.

steps.t: Take the south east ladder down.
Follow the tunnel south, then go up the ladder there.
Take the east ladder down.
Follow the path around until you reach a ladder, then climb it.
Take the north ladder down.
Kill the Ice Queen for ice gloves.
Pick up the ice gloves.
Bank every weapon and piece of armour, keep the ice gloves, and travel to Entrana with the monks in Port Sarim.
steps.s: Bank weapons and armour; take the monks in Port Sarim to Entrana.

steps.t: Kill the Entrana firebird on the north of Entrana.
steps.s: Kill the Entrana firebird in the north of Entrana.

steps.t: Wear the ice gloves and pick up the fire feather.

With a partner from the other Shield of Arrav gang, get a thieves' armband in Brimhaven (Black Arm: black armour, Grip's key; Phoenix: kill Grip with Ranged or Magic). Bring Achietties the lava eel, fire feather and armband.
steps.s: Get the thieves' armband with your partner, then go to Achietties.

steps: Travel to Miscellania (Either go to Rellekka middle dock to travel by sailor or fairy code: )
If you do not have flowers yet, buy some from the Flower Girl in the castle courtyard for 15gp.
Speak with King Vargas on the of the south-west castle. Dialogue:
Speak with Princess Astrid in the room directly north of the King. Continue to speak with her each time the dialogue box closes, until the dialogue is just "Good Day".
Use the flowers on the princess (You will not get them back)
Now use the dance emote inside her room
Keep speaking with her, choosing the flattering options (see below) until the dialogue is just "Good Day".
Use the bow in your inventory on her (you will not get it back)
Speak with her again
Use the blow kiss emote
Repeat the agreeing process once more until she calls you "Dear" or "Darling"
Use the blow kiss emote again
Use the ring in your inventory on her (you will not get it back)
Speak with Prince Brand in the room directly south of the King. Continue to speak with him each time the dialogue box closes, until the dialogue is just "Good Day".
After he recites the poem select "Be still, my heart"
Use the Clap or Cheer emote in his room
Keep speaking with him, agreeing with everything he says. Eventually the dialogue will just be "Good Day".
Use the flowers on the prince
Repeat the agreeing process
Use (do not eat) the cake on him
Repeat the agreeing process
Once the dialogue goes "Hello, dear." and "Hello Darling." use the blow kiss emote in his room
Use your ring on him and he will agree to marry you (silver and pineapple rings do not work)

Exit the castle and head east, across the bridge to the other castle. It's advised to clear the weeds from the herb and flax crops outside the main gates of the Miscellania castle every time you run past to save time on gaining favour which you need later on in the quest. If doing this, players can expect to have around 60% favour by the time they will need to gain the remaining favour.
Speak with Queen Sigrid upstairs
Return west and speak with King Vargas
Return east and speak with the Queen again
Go back again and speak with Prince Brand in the room south of King Vargas to receive the Awful anthem
Speak with Advisor Ghrim who is next to the King Dialogue: to turn the Awful anthem into a Good anthem
Take the Good Anthem to the Queen to the East to get the Treaty
Take the treaty back to King Vargas
Leave the castle and head north to the anvil symbol
Speak with Derrik with an iron bar in your inventory Dialogue: to receive a giant nib
Use the giant nib on the logs in your inventory to create a Giant pen
Return to the King

steps: Talk to Lokar Searunner on the western most Rellekka docks. D*K*S closest fairy ring. Dialogue: "You've been away from these parts a while?", "Why did you leave?", "Why not, I've always wondered what the state of my innards are!"
Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a Seal of Passage. Dialogue: "Ask about a Seal of Passage."
Return to Lokar Searunner. Dialogue: "Arrr! Yar! Let's be on our way, yar!"
Climb the ladders, and board the pirate ship. Talk to Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle. Dialogue: "Can we sail to Lunar Isle now?"
Speak to Captain Bentley again.
Climb down the nearby south stairs through the door, talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack.
Climb back up the stairs and talk to Captain Bentley again. Dialogue: "Perhaps it's the Navigator's fault?"
Climb back down the stairs and return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack again.
Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front (north-end deckside) of the ship.
Talk to the Cabin boy up one deck from the captain (south).
Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship.
Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee at the very top-rear of the ship.
Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy', on the deck level, south room.
Climb back up to the top, talk to the Cabin boy (2 inventory spaces required).
Use the emerald lens on the bullseye lantern you brought. Light it with your tinderbox.
Use the lantern on the following objects, and rub away the symbols:
Talk to Captain Bentley.
Climb down the ladders and walk into the city (there will be a small cut-scene).
Run out of the city to the south-east part of the island. Talk to the Oneiromancer.
Kill Suqah (safespottable), until you've received a suqah tooth. Keep any hides you get as drops (you will need a total of 4 hides later in the quest, which you can also collect later).
Return to the city, northern section. Enter the chicken house and talk to Baba Yaga (1 inventory space required). Dialogue: "The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help..."
Exit the house and use the vial on a nearby water source.
Return to the Oneiromancer with the potion.
Use your Dramen staff/staves on the following altars in order:
Travel back to Lunar Isle and give the Lunar staff to the Oneiromancer. Do not forget to bring your Seal of Passage.
In the north-eastern part of the isle, climb down ladder to the Lunar Mine.
Mine a stalagmite for 1 lunar ore. Grab three extra ores to save time during The Fremennik Exiles quest.
Smelt the ore at a furnace or superheat the ore to receive a lunar bar (closest furnace and anvil is in Rellekka).
With a hammer, use the bar on an anvil to make the helm.
Go back to the Lunar Isle.

North-west in the city, talk to Pauline Polaris (1 inventory space required) Note: The chat options appear in a random order when guessing her real name. First guess must be Pauline. Pick the option that says "Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid."
South in the city, talk to Meteora.
Kill Suqahs until one drops a special tiara. Keep up to 4 hides the Suqahs drop. Make sure you have at least 4 hides.
Give Meteora the tiara.
South of the bank, talk to Rimae Sirsalis about ceremonial clothes. Dialogue: "You know the ceremonial clothes?"
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again, she will tan your hides. Dialogue: "You know the ceremonial clothes?", "That seems like a fair deal."
Craft a Lunar torso, trousers, gloves and boots from your hides.
Centre of the city, talk to Selene. Dialogue: "I'm looking for a ring."
Exit the city and run south then west past the two bridges. With your spade, dig up the blue flowers furthest west to receive the lunar ring. (You must click continue on the chatbox!)

steps: Speak to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in the north-west corner of East Ardougne. Dialogue: "Why can't you get it yourself?", "Yes."
Enter the temple directly south of the Ranging Guild by climbing down the ladder.
Go west down the stairs, slash the web, and take the boots of lightness (light source and knife or slash weapon required).
Go back upstairs, then through the north gate with the pendant of Lucien equipped.
Cross the lava bridge wearing the boots of lightness (weight must be -1 kg or less or you will not be able to cross and take 20 damage from falling), open the Large door, and take the lever.
Cross the lava bridge again and attach the lever to the lever-bracket on the wall a bit west of the ladder you climbed to enter the dungeon.
Pull the lever after attaching it. You will receive the prompt: "You hear the clunking of some hidden machinery."
Go through the south gate and follow the path.
Search chests along the icy path to obtain ice arrows. 16 with Ava's device and 60+ Ranged is enough.
Go back through the north gate with the pendant of Lucien equipped.
Continue straight north to a small room containing a lever.
Right-click the lever and search for traps. (Requires 42 Thieving) Then pull the lever.
Go west then north through the doors.
A Fire Warrior of Lesarkus will spawn in the room upon attempting to enter the second door.
Kill him with your ice arrows.
Give Winelda 20 unnoted limpwurt roots all at once. She will teleport you to the other side of the lava.
Optional: follow the path to its end and take the shiny key to access this dungeon from McGrubor's Wood.
Push the wall to the north leading to a room full of Guardians of Armadyl.
Pick the good or evil path.

Remove your pendant of Lucien and talk to a Guardian of Armadyl. Dialogue: "I seek the Staff of Armadyl.", "Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!", "You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.", "Ok! I'll help!"
Enter the building west of the Grand Exchange wearing your Armadyl pendant and kill Lucien (level 14).
Take the Staff of Armadyl from the table, you may have to kill a level 43 Guardian of Armadyl.
Enter the building west of the Grand Exchange and give Lucien the Staff of Armadyl.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Speak to Grish located in Jiggig west of the Gu'Tanoth and south of Castle Wars (east of fairy ring ) and offer to help. Dialogue: "What do you mean sickies?", "Can I help in any way?", "Yes."
Speak to Ogre guard to the east, he will remove the barricade to gain access to the Zogre-infested area.
Climb over the crushed barricade and run east to a set of stairs going downwards, go down these stairs.
Run north-west to an area with a blackened floor, a short cut scene will begin.
Search the skeleton next to the broken lectern. A Zombie will appear and attack, kill it to obtain the Ruined backpack.
Open the ruined backpack to obtain a Dragon inn tankard, some rotten food and a knife.
Search the broken lectern for the Torn page (make sure you keep this).
Attempt to search the coffin west of the Skeleton, and then use a knife on it.
Attempt to open coffin (may take a couple of tries), search the coffin for the black prism.
Go to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the dragon inn tankard on the bartender. The Minigame Teleport to Nightmare Zone can take you here quickly.

Speak to Zavistic Rarve in the Wizards' Guild in Yanille (if you don't have the required level to enter, ring the bell out front). (Dialogue: "I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres" if you have started Hand in the Sand)
Speak to Sithik Ints in his bed in the upstairs bedroom in the guest house north of the Wizards' Guild Dialogue: "Do you mind if I look around?"
Search the drawers, cupboard and wardrobe for Book of portraiture, Necromancy book, papyrus, charcoal, and a book of 'H.A.M'.
Read all three books.
Use all three books on Sithik.
Use Papyrus on Sithik.
Use portrait on Sithik.
Go to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the Dragon Inn Tankard, then the portrait on the Bartender.

Speak to Zavistic Rarve while holding the Necromancy book, book of 'H.A.M', the tankard and the signed portrait. Dialogue: "I have some items that I'd like you to look at." or {{Chat option|1I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres}{Chat option|3I have some items that I'd like you to look at.}} if you have started Hand in the Sand.
Use the Strange potion on the Cup of tea on top of Sithik's drawers.
Go downstairs and back upstairs.

Speak to Sithik, obtain answers to all three questions in order to make Relicym's balm and Brutal arrows Dialogue: "How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area?", "How do I get rid of the undead ogres", "How do I get rid of the disease", "Sorry, I have to go.".
Return and speak to Grish Dialogue: "I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.". He will give you an Ogre gate key to access the Ceremonial chamber.
Talk to Grish again "There must be an easier way to kill these Zogres" to learn how to equip Composite ogre bows Dialogue: .
Prepare to fight Slash Bash (level 111). If you are using an comp ogre bow instead of Crumble Undead, follow the "optional" steps below.
Chop an Achey Tree for logs.
Use a knife on the achey tree logs with wolf bones in your inventory, and select box number (2) to create an unstrung comp bow.
String the bow with bow string to create the finished bow.

Either buy one from the Grand Exchange or make it yourself by adding Rogue's purse to a Vial of water and then add Snake weed. It is not needed for the quest but giving it to Uglug Nar will allow you to purchase Relicym's balm from his shop if needed in the future.
Cut down Achey Trees for Achey tree logs.
Fletch the logs with a knife into Ogre arrow shafts.
Add feathers to the shafts.
With a hammer in your inventory use nails on the Flighted ogre arrows.
Head back down into Jiggig.
Travel west until you reach two sets of doors.
Go through both doors and go down the stairs.
Follow the chamber to the end and search the stand.
Kill Slash Bash and collect the Zogre bones and Ogre artefact that he drops.
Return and speak to Grish. Dialogue:
Congratulations, quest complete!
